entries.it: Dispositivo della segnaletica verticale che dà ai conducenti un avvertimento, una prescrizione o una notizia; si distingue in segnali di pericolo, di prescrizione e di indicazione.
entries.ru: знак (дорожный знак) — установленное у дороги средство вертикальной сигнализации, которое предупреждает об опасности, предписывает поведение или сообщает сведения; делится на знаки опасности, предписывающие и информационные.
entries.en: sign (road sign) — a roadside vertical signing device that warns of a hazard, imposes a rule, or gives information; divided into danger, prescription and indication signs.
entries.uz: yo'l belgisi — yo'l chetiga o'rnatilgan vertikal belgi bo'lib, xavfdan ogohlantiradi, qoidani buyuradi yoki ma'lumot beradi; xavf, buyruq-taqiq va axborot belgilariga bo'linadi.
entries.trap: segnale is a road SIGN — знак / yo'l belgisi. Never сигнал / signal / signal. "Il segnale raffigurato" opens 2729 of 7106 questions; rendering it as "signal" turns every one of them into a question about a light or a horn. The horn is the segnalatore/avvisatore acustico and the act of using it is a segnalazione.

entries.it: Prerogativa, propria di una strada o di un senso di marcia, di passare per primi; è portata dal segnale DIRITTO DI PRECEDENZA e cessa con FINE DEL DIRITTO DI PRECEDENZA; non esonera dalla prudenza.
entries.ru: право преимущественного проезда — постоянное свойство дороги (или направления движения) проезжать первой, обозначаемое знаками DIRITTO DI PRECEDENZA и FINE DEL DIRITTO DI PRECEDENZA; оно не освобождает водителя от обязанности соблюдать осторожность.
entries.en: right of way / priority — a standing property of a ROAD (or of one direction of travel) to go first, conferred by the DIRITTO DI PRECEDENZA sign and ended by FINE DEL DIRITTO DI PRECEDENZA; it never excuses a lack of care.
entries.uz: ustunlik huquqi — yo'lning (yoki harakat yo'nalishining) birinchi bo'lib o'tish doimiy huquqi; DIRITTO DI PRECEDENZA belgisi bilan beriladi va FINE DEL DIRITTO DI PRECEDENZA bilan tugaydi; ehtiyotkorlik majburiyatidan ozod qilmaydi.
entries.trap: Two mistakes. (1) It is a permanent attribute of the road and the name of a real sign — "strada che gode del diritto di precedenza" — not the momentary act of yielding, which is dare la precedenza. (2) Having it does not license speed or inattention: "Il conducente può fare a meno di usare la massima prudenza quando si avvicina ad un incrocio in cui ha il diritto di precedenza" is FALSE, and "Il diritto di precedenza non autorizza il conducente ad attraversare l'incrocio senza usare prudenza" is TRUE.

entries.it: Parte della strada, rialzata o comunque delimitata e protetta, destinata al riparo e alla sosta dei pedoni in corrispondenza di attraversamenti pedonali o di fermate dei mezzi pubblici.
entries.ru: островок безопасности — приподнятый или огороженный участок дороги, служащий убежищем и местом ожидания для пешеходов у пешеходного перехода либо для посадки и высадки пассажиров трамвая, троллейбуса, автобуса.
entries.en: pedestrian refuge island — a raised or otherwise marked-off, protected part of the road that shelters pedestrians at a crossing and lets passengers board and alight from trams, trolleybuses and buses.
entries.uz: piyodalar uchun xavfsizlik orolchasi — piyodalar o'tish joyida piyodalarni himoya qiladigan hamda tramvay, trolleybus va avtobus yo'lovchilarining chiqib-tushishiga xizmat qiladigan ko'tarilgan yoki ajratilgan yo'l qismi.
entries.trap: In everyday Italian salvagente is a lifebuoy or a lifeguard; in the Codice della Strada it is a pedestrian refuge island. The bank exploits the everyday sense with deliberately absurd false statements — "Il salvagente è una persona preposta al primo soccorso" is FALSE, "Il passo carrabile è un salvagente circolare per i pedoni" is FALSE. Second trap: it shelters PEOPLE. Channelling vehicles is the isola di traffico's job, so "Il salvagente serve a incanalare i veicoli in varie direzioni" is FALSE while the same sentence about the isola di traffico is TRUE.

entries.it: Annuncia in anticipo ciò che si incontrerà più avanti: è l'azione propria dei segnali di pericolo, collocati di norma 150 m prima del punto pericoloso fuori dei centri abitati.
entries.ru: предупреждает заранее (о том, что впереди) — сообщает о том, что встретится ДАЛЬШЕ по дороге; это действие знаков опасности, которые вне населённых пунктов ставятся, как правило, за 150 м до опасного места.
entries.en: gives advance warning of — announces what will be met FURTHER ON; this is what danger signs do, posted as a rule 150 m before the hazard outside built-up areas.
entries.uz: oldindan ogohlantiradi — OLDINDA uchraydigan narsa haqida xabar beradi; bu xavf belgilarining vazifasi, ular aholi punktlaridan tashqarida odatda xavfli joydan 150 m oldin o'rnatiladi.
entries.trap: preannuncia and indica are NOT the same verb and the bank pairs them on purpose. For the danger sign: "Il segnale raffigurato preannuncia una curva pericolosa a destra" is TRUE, while "Il segnale raffigurato indica una curva pericolosa a destra" is FALSE. Russian указывает and English "indicates" serve for both, which makes the two statements textually identical and the pair impossible to learn. Keep a distinct forward-looking verb for preannuncia.

entries.it: Dà notizia anticipata, mediante apposito segnale di preavviso, di una prescrizione o di una direzione poste più avanti, spesso con l'indicazione della distanza.
entries.ru: предварительно извещает (предварительный знак) — заранее сообщает о ПРЕДПИСАНИИ или направлении, которые появятся дальше, посредством особого знака предварительного указания (segnale di preavviso), часто с указанием расстояния.
entries.en: gives advance notice of — announces beforehand a PRESCRIPTION or a direction that lies ahead, by means of a dedicated advance-notice sign (segnale di preavviso), often with a stated distance.
entries.uz: oldindan xabar beradi — oldinda kutilayotgan BUYRUQ yoki yo'nalish haqida maxsus oldindan xabar beruvchi belgi (segnale di preavviso) orqali, ko'pincha masofa ko'rsatilgan holda, ma'lum qiladi.
entries.trap: A third distinct verb, tied to a named family of signs — PREAVVISO DI DARE PRECEDENZA, preavviso di direzione obbligatoria, preavviso di bivio, preavviso di deviazione — and often carrying a distance ("preavvisa che a 70 metri inizia…"). It is not what danger signs do: "Il segnale raffigurato è un segnale di preavviso di pericolo" is FALSE (a danger sign preannuncia). RU/EN/UZ all reach for the same single word as for preannuncia and indica; give each of the three its own verb or three separate question families collapse into one.

entries.it: Participio con cui la domanda rinvia all'immagine allegata: «il segnale raffigurato» è il segnale mostrato nella figura, non un segnale qualsiasi.
entries.ru: изображённый (на рисунке) — причастие, которым вопрос отсылает к прилагаемой картинке: «il segnale raffigurato» значит «знак, показанный на рисунке», а не какой-то знак вообще.
entries.en: depicted / shown (in the picture) — the participle by which the question points at the attached image: "il segnale raffigurato" means the sign shown in the figure, not just any sign.
entries.uz: tasvirlangan (rasmdagi) — savol ilova qilingan rasmga havola qiladigan sifatdosh: «il segnale raffigurato» — rasmda ko'rsatilgan belgi, har qanday belgi emas.
entries.trap: It appears in 2833 of 7106 questions (40%) and it names nothing: it is a pointer to the picture. Do not translate it as "the aforementioned sign" or "the said sign", and never drop it — the learner then cannot tell which object the statement is about, and must not be given a guessed sign name in its place.

entries.it: Pannello posto sotto un segnale per integrarne o precisarne il significato: distanza d'inizio, estensione del tratto, validità temporale, categorie di veicoli o eccezioni.
entries.ru: дополнительная табличка — щиток, установленный ПОД знаком и уточняющий его: расстояние до начала действия, протяжённость участка, время действия, категории транспортных средств или исключения.
entries.en: supplementary plate — a small panel fixed UNDER a sign that completes or narrows its meaning: distance to where it starts, length of the stretch it covers, hours of validity, vehicle categories or exceptions.
entries.uz: qo'shimcha lavha — belgi OSTIGA o'rnatiladigan va uning ma'nosini to'ldiruvchi taxtacha: amal boshlanadigan masofa, uchastka uzunligi, amal qilish vaqti, transport toifalari yoki istisnolar.
entries.trap: It is not the sign; it modifies the sign, and the SAME panel means different things depending on what it hangs under. Under a danger sign, a distance panel gives the distance from the sign to where the hazard begins; under an obbligo or divieto sign, the distance from which the rule starts; another panel gives the LENGTH of the stretch covered. A learner who reads "pannello integrativo" as "the sign" answers about the wrong object entirely.

entries.it: Parte della strada, delimitata da strisce bianche continue e zebrature, a raso o rialzata e non transitabile, destinata a incanalare i veicoli verso le varie direzioni.
entries.ru: направляющий островок — часть дороги, обозначенная сплошными белыми линиями и белой «зеброй», в одном уровне с проезжей частью или приподнятая, ЗАПРЕЩЁННАЯ для проезда, служащая для направления потоков транспорта по разным направлениям.
entries.en: traffic island (channelling island) — a part of the road bounded by solid white lines and white chevron hatching, either flush or raised, closed to all vehicles, whose purpose is to funnel traffic into its various directions.
entries.uz: yo'naltiruvchi orolcha — uzluksiz oq chiziqlar va oq zebra bilan chegaralangan, yo'l sathida yoki ko'tarilgan, harakat uchun TAQIQLANGAN yo'l qismi; transport oqimlarini turli yo'nalishlarga yo'naltirish uchun xizmat qiladi.
entries.trap: No vehicle may drive over it, and the bank tests exactly that with plausible-sounding exemptions: "L'isola di traffico può essere percorsa solo dai taxi e dagli autobus urbani" is FALSE, and so is the version allowing ciclomotori. It is also not the salvagente: "L'isola di traffico facilita la salita e la discesa di passeggeri da tram, filobus e autobus" is FALSE, and it is not a parking bay, a turning bay, or the busy centre of town.

entries.it: Insieme dei mezzi di segnalamento stradale: segnaletica verticale (segnali e pannelli), orizzontale (strisce e scritte sulla pavimentazione), luminosa e complementare.
entries.ru: дорожные знаки и разметка в совокупности (система средств организации движения) — собирательное понятие: вертикальная (знаки и таблички), горизонтальная (линии и надписи на покрытии), световая и дополнительная сигнализация.
entries.en: road signing and markings as a system — the collective body of signing means: vertical (signs and plates), horizontal (lines and legends painted on the surface), luminous, and complementary devices.
entries.uz: yo'l belgilari va chiziqlari majmuasi — yo'l harakatini tartibga soluvchi vositalar tizimi: vertikal (belgilar va lavhalar), gorizontal (yo'l ustidagi chiziq va yozuvlar), yorug'likli va qo'shimcha vositalar.
entries.trap: segnaletica is collective, not "a sign". "È vietato spostare o imbrattare la segnaletica stradale" covers road markings, delineators, barriers and cones as well — the bank proves it by making "È consentito spostare la segnaletica stradale, se si tratta delle barriere di delimitazione o dei coni stradali" FALSE. Read it as a single sign and you answer far too narrowly. Note also the phrase splits: segnaletica orizzontale = markings, segnaletica verticale = signs.

entries.it: Linea della segnaletica orizzontale tracciata sulla pavimentazione; il colore (bianca, gialla) e il tipo (continua o discontinua) ne determinano la prescrizione.
entries.ru: линия разметки (полоса) — линия горизонтальной разметки, нанесённая на покрытие; её цвет (белая, жёлтая) и характер (сплошная или прерывистая) определяют, что именно она предписывает.
entries.en: road-marking line (stripe) — a line of the horizontal marking painted on the road surface; its colour (white, yellow) and its type (solid or broken) determine the rule it carries.
entries.uz: yo'l chizig'i (razmetka chizig'i) — yo'l qoplamasiga chizilgan gorizontal razmetka chizig'i; rangi (oq, sariq) va turi (uzluksiz yoki uzuq-uzuq) qanday talab qo'yishini belgilaydi.
entries.trap: The striscia is the painted LINE; the corsia is the lane it delimits — do not swap them. Continuity is the rule-carrier: a striscia continua may not be crossed, a discontinua may be crossed but neither may be straddled ("circolare stando a cavallo di essa" is FALSE for both the broken line and the double line). Colour changes the rule too: white lines separate lanes and directions, yellow ones mark reserved or forbidden areas (bus-stop zig-zag, disabled bays). Centre lines are never blue — "Le strisce lungo il centro della carreggiata possono essere bianche o azzurre" is FALSE.

entries.it: Prescrizione che impone un determinato comportamento; i relativi segnali di obbligo, circolari a fondo azzurro, appartengono ai segnali di prescrizione.
entries.ru: предписание, обязанность — требование, ОБЯЗЫВАЮЩЕЕ вести себя определённым образом; предписывающие знаки (segnali di obbligo) — круглые с синим фоном — входят в группу знаков предписания.
entries.en: obligation, mandatory order — a rule that COMPELS a specific behaviour; the mandatory signs (segnali di obbligo), round with a blue background, belong to the prescription-sign family.
entries.uz: majburiyat, majburiy ko'rsatma — muayyan xatti-harakatni BAJARISHGA majbur qiluvchi talab; buyruq belgilari (segnali di obbligo) — ko'k fonli doira shaklidagi belgilar — buyruq-taqiq belgilari guruhiga kiradi.
entries.trap: The modal is the whole answer. "È obbligatorio" (you must) is not "è consentito" (you may) and not "è opportuno" (it is advisable) — the bank builds its most common true/false items by swapping exactly these. Translate the modal strength literally: an Uzbek or Russian rendering that softens obbligatorio into "нужно / kerak" or hardens consentito into "должен / shart" flips the answer.

entries.it: Prescrizione che vieta un determinato comportamento; i relativi segnali di divieto, circolari a fondo bianco con bordo rosso, appartengono ai segnali di prescrizione.
entries.ru: запрет, запрещение — требование, ЗАПРЕЩАЮЩЕЕ определённое поведение; запрещающие знаки (segnali di divieto) — круглые, с белым фоном и красной каймой — входят в группу знаков предписания.
entries.en: prohibition, ban — a rule that FORBIDS a specific behaviour; the prohibitory signs (segnali di divieto), round with a white background and a red border, belong to the prescription-sign family.
entries.uz: taqiq, man etish — muayyan xatti-harakatni TAQIQLOVCHI talab; taqiqlovchi belgilar (segnali di divieto) — oq fonli va qizil hoshiyali doira shaklidagi belgilar — buyruq-taqiq belgilari guruhiga kiradi.
entries.trap: divieto forbids, obbligo compels — two similar-sounding Italian nouns carrying opposite duties, and both sit inside the wider class prescrizione, which is neither. A learner who renders both as a vague "restriction / ограничение / cheklov" cannot read any red-bordered sign. Note also that a divieto ends: "fine del divieto" and "segnale di fine prescrizione" cancel it, and the bank tests those as separate signs.

entries.it: Segnale complementare posto ai margini della carreggiata, o nelle gallerie, per rendere visibile l'andamento della strada, utile soprattutto in caso di scarsa visibilità.
entries.ru: делинеатор, сигнальный столбик — ДОПОЛНИТЕЛЬНОЕ средство сигнализации (segnale complementare), устанавливаемое по краям проезжей части или в туннелях, чтобы обозначить направление хода дороги; особенно полезно при плохой видимости.
entries.en: delineator / edge marker post — a COMPLEMENTARY signing device (segnale complementare) set along the edges of the carriageway or inside tunnels to make the course of the road visible, especially in poor visibility.
entries.uz: delineator, yo'l chekkasi ustunchasi — yo'lning yo'nalishini ko'rsatish uchun yo'l chetiga yoki tunnellarga o'rnatiladigan QO'SHIMCHA signal vositasi (segnale complementare); ayniqsa yomon ko'rinuvchanlikda foydali.
entries.trap: A delineatore only shows where the road goes. It gives no order, so any statement that it obliges, forbids, or announces a prohibition is FALSE — "Il delineatore raffigurato indica un divieto di sosta" is FALSE, while "Il delineatore raffigurato indica una curva pericolosa a destra" is TRUE because that is pure course information. Two further false claims the bank uses: delineators do NOT divide the carriageway into lanes, and they are not "visible only at night" (they help most in poor visibility, day or night).

entries.it: Impianto di lanterne semaforiche che regola la circolazione con luci rossa, gialla e verde; ne esistono di veicolari, pedonali, ciclabili, di corsia e per corsie reversibili.
entries.ru: светофор — установка светофорных секций, регулирующая движение красным, жёлтым и зелёным огнём; бывает транспортный, пешеходный, велосипедный, полосный (для отдельной полосы) и для реверсивных полос.
entries.en: traffic light (traffic-signal installation) — a set of signal lanterns regulating traffic with red, amber and green lights; there are vehicle, pedestrian, cycle, lane, and reversible-lane types.
entries.uz: svetofor — harakatni qizil, sariq va yashil chiroq bilan tartibga soluvchi svetofor qurilmasi; transport, piyoda, velosiped, qatorlar uchun va reversiv qatorlar uchun turlari mavjud.
entries.trap: Russian светофор is safe, but English "signal" and loose Uzbek renderings drag semaforo, segnale and segnalazione into one word, and the categories carry different rules. A semaforo is a light installation, not a sign board: overtaking near or at an intersection is ALLOWED when the intersection is regolata da semafori ("È consentito il sorpasso in prossimità o in corrispondenza delle intersezioni se regolate dai semafori" is TRUE), a rule that has no counterpart for signs.

entries.it: Luce del semaforo: se fissa impone di arrestarsi prima della striscia di arresto, ove possibile in sicurezza, e di liberare l'incrocio già impegnato; se lampeggiante, si passa con prudenza.
entries.ru: жёлтый сигнал светофора — ПОСТОЯННЫЙ (fissa) обязывает остановиться перед стоп-линией, если это можно сделать безопасно, а того, кто уже въехал на перекрёсток, — как можно скорее его освободить; МИГАЮЩИЙ (lampeggiante) разрешает проезд с повышенной осторожностью.
entries.en: amber light — FIXED (fissa) requires you to stop before the stop line where that can be done safely, and requires anyone already in the junction to clear it as quickly as possible; FLASHING (lampeggiante) lets you proceed, with the greatest caution and reduced speed.
entries.uz: sariq chiroq — DOIMIY (fissa) yonganda to'xtash chizig'idan oldin xavfsiz to'xtash shart, chorrahaga allaqachon kirgan haydovchi esa uni tezroq bo'shatishi lozim; MILTILLOVCHI (lampeggiante) esa katta ehtiyotkorlik va tezlikni pasaytirgan holda o'tishga ruxsat beradi.
entries.trap: fissa and lampeggiante are two different legal rules hiding under one phrase; collapsing them gives the wrong answer every time. Fixed amber does NOT mean "stop in every case" ("La luce gialla fissa ci obbliga ad arrestarci in ogni caso, senza impegnare l'incrocio" is FALSE) and does NOT mean "always carry on" either. Flashing amber never imposes an arrest ("Nel semaforo la luce gialla lampeggiante impone l'arresto sempre prima dell'incrocio" is FALSE). Note the timing facts too: fixed amber comes on as green goes out, and goes out before red comes on.

entries.it: Segnale realizzato con dispositivi a luce (art. 41 C.d.S.): comprende le lanterne semaforiche veicolari, pedonali, ciclabili e di corsia e i segnali luminosi di pericolo o indicazione.
entries.ru: световой знак / светосигнальное устройство — знак, выполненный светящимися устройствами (ст. 41 ПДД Италии): к нему относятся светофорные секции для транспорта, пешеходов, велосипедистов и отдельных полос, а также светящиеся знаки опасности и информации.
entries.en: luminous signal (light-signal unit) — a road signal realised with light devices (art. 41 Codice della Strada): it covers vehicle, pedestrian, cycle and lane signal lanterns as well as illuminated danger or indication signs.
entries.uz: yorug'likli belgi (chiroqli signal qurilmasi) — yorug'lik qurilmalari yordamida amalga oshirilgan yo'l belgisi (Italiya YHQ 41-moddasi): transport, piyoda, velosiped va qator svetofor sektsiyalarini hamda yorituvchi xavf va axborot belgilarini o'z ichiga oladi.
entries.trap: It is a fixed installation belonging to the road — in this question bank it is almost always a semaforo ("Il segnale luminoso in figura è un semaforo per i pedoni" is TRUE). Do not merge it with segnalazione luminosa di pericolo, which is the DRIVER's own hazard flashers on the vehicle, nor flatten it to "light": it is still a segnale that regulates traffic, and "il segnale luminoso indica la presenza di una scuola" is the kind of false statement that only reads as false once the category is clear.

entries.it: Parte della carreggiata, evidenziata da strisce bianche parallele, destinata al transito dei pedoni che attraversano, ai quali va data la precedenza; vi sono vietate fermata e sosta.
entries.ru: пешеходный переход — ЧАСТЬ ПРОЕЗЖЕЙ ЧАСТИ, обозначенная параллельными белыми полосами и предназначенная для перехода пешеходов, которым водители обязаны уступать дорогу; на нём запрещены и остановка (fermata), и стоянка (sosta).
entries.en: pedestrian crossing — a PART OF THE CARRIAGEWAY marked out by parallel white stripes and set aside for pedestrians crossing, to whom drivers must give way; both stopping (fermata) and parking (sosta) are forbidden on it.
entries.uz: piyodalar o'tish joyi — parallel oq chiziqlar bilan belgilangan va piyodalar o'tishi uchun mo'ljallangan YO'L QATNOV QISMINING BIR BO'LAGI; haydovchilar piyodalarga yo'l berishi shart, bu yerda to'xtash (fermata) ham, qo'yish (sosta) ham taqiqlanadi.
entries.trap: Three separate rules ride on one phrase, and each is tested. (1) It IS part of the carreggiata — "L'attraversamento pedonale non fa parte della carreggiata" and "è posto al di fuori della carreggiata" are both FALSE, and it is not closed to vehicles. (2) BOTH fermata and sosta are banned, so "è consentita la fermata ma non la sosta" is FALSE — this is exactly where the arresto/fermata/sosta distinction bites. (3) Precedenza is owed to a blind pedestrian with a white or white-and-red stick even OUTSIDE the stripes.

entries.it: Atto o mezzo del segnalare: acustica (clacson), luminosa di pericolo (quattro frecce), degli agenti; «salvo diversa segnalazione» significa se i segnali non dispongono altrimenti.
entries.ru: подача сигнала, сигнализация (ДЕЙСТВИЕ) — сам акт или средство подачи сигнала: segnalazione acustica — звуковой сигнал, клаксон; segnalazione luminosa di pericolo — аварийная световая сигнализация; segnalazione degli agenti — жесты регулировщика; оборот «salvo diversa segnalazione» = «если знаки не предписывают иного».
entries.en: signalling — the ACT or means of signalling: segnalazione acustica is the horn, segnalazione luminosa di pericolo is the hazard flashers, segnalazione degli agenti is a police officer's directions; "salvo diversa segnalazione" means "unless the signs say otherwise".
entries.uz: signal berish (HARAKAT yoki vosita) — signal berish akti yoki vositasi: segnalazione acustica — tovushli signal, klakson; segnalazione luminosa di pericolo — avariya chiroqlari; segnalazione degli agenti — nazoratchining ishoralari; «salvo diversa segnalazione» — «agar belgilar boshqacha ko'rsatmasa».
entries.trap: segnalazione is the act of signalling; segnale is the sign board. One word for both makes "Il segnale raffigurato vieta le segnalazioni acustiche" (TRUE — the sign bans use of the horn) collapse into nonsense. Keep them apart in all three languages, and keep the three fixed phrases distinct: segnalazione acustica = horn, segnalazione luminosa di pericolo = hazard flashers (NOT a light sign), salvo diversa segnalazione = unless signs prescribe otherwise, which is the qualifier attached to almost every speed-limit item in the bank.

entries.it: Esprime ciò che il segnale dispone o rende noto nel punto in cui è collocato, non più avanti: è il verbo dei segnali di obbligo, di divieto e di indicazione.
entries.ru: указывает (то, что действует ЗДЕСЬ) — выражает то, что знак предписывает или сообщает В МЕСТЕ своей установки, а не дальше по дороге; это глагол предписывающих, запрещающих и информационных знаков.
entries.en: indicates (states what applies HERE) — expresses what the sign orders or makes known AT the point where it stands, not further along; it is the verb of mandatory, prohibitory and indication signs.
entries.uz: ko'rsatadi (SHU YERDA amal qiladigan narsani bildiradi) — belgi o'rnatilgan JOYDA nimani buyurishi yoki bildirishini ifodalaydi, oldinroqda emas; bu buyruq, taqiq va axborot belgilarining fe'li.
entries.trap: indica is here-and-now; preannuncia is up-ahead. The bank pairs them on the SAME sign: "Il segnale raffigurato indica l'obbligo di svoltare a sinistra" is TRUE while "preannuncia l'obbligo di svoltare a sinistra" is FALSE, and conversely "preannuncia una curva pericolosa a destra" is TRUE while "indica una curva pericolosa a destra" is FALSE. Rendering indica and preannuncia with one verb makes each pair textually identical and the whole family unlearnable.

entries.it: Sospensione della marcia del veicolo protratta nel tempo, con possibilità del conducente di allontanarsi dal veicolo.
entries.ru: стоянка — приостановка движения на продолжительное время, при которой водитель вправе покинуть автомобиль и уйти.
entries.en: parking (prolonged standing) — a suspension of the vehicle's movement protracted in time, with the driver free to walk away from the vehicle.
entries.uz: to'xtab turish — transport vositasi harakatining uzoq muddatga to'xtatilishi; haydovchi mashinadan uzoqlashishi mumkin.
entries.trap: Sosta is the ONLY one of the three where the driver may leave the vehicle. Glossing it with RU остановка or UZ to'xtash merges it with fermata and flips the whole 'è consentita la fermata ma non la sosta' family.

entries.it: Temporanea sospensione della marcia per la salita o la discesa delle persone o per altre esigenze di brevissima durata; il conducente deve restare presente e pronto a riprendere la marcia.
entries.ru: остановка (кратковременная, по воле водителя) — временное прекращение движения для посадки/высадки людей или иных очень краткосрочных нужд; водитель обязан оставаться за рулём.
entries.en: brief halt / stopping — a temporary suspension of movement to let people get in or out, or for other very short needs, with the driver staying present and ready to move off.
entries.uz: to'xtash — odamlarni tushirish/o'tqazish yoki juda qisqa ehtiyoj uchun harakatning vaqtincha to'xtatilishi; haydovchi rulda qolishi shart.
entries.trap: 'La fermata è l'interruzione della marcia dovuta ad esigenze della circolazione' is FALSE — that is arresto. Fermata is driver-chosen and the driver may NOT walk away ('può allontanarsi per brevissimo tempo' is FALSE). A second sense, piazzola/segnale di fermata, is the bus stop.

entries.it: Interruzione della marcia del veicolo dovuta ad esigenze della circolazione (semaforo rosso, segnale di STOP, agente del traffico), non alla volontà del conducente.
entries.ru: остановка по требованию движения — прекращение движения, вызванное дорожной обстановкой (красный сигнал, знак STOP, регулировщик), а не желанием водителя.
entries.en: forced stop (halt required by traffic) — an interruption of movement imposed by traffic conditions — a red light, a STOP sign, an officer — never chosen by the driver.
entries.uz: harakat talabiga ko'ra to'xtatish — qizil chiroq, STOP belgisi yoki nazoratchi talabi bilan yuzaga keladigan to'xtash; haydovchining xohishi bilan emas.
entries.trap: 'L'arresto è la temporanea sospensione della marcia per esigenze del conducente o dei passeggeri' is FALSE — driver-chosen halts are fermata. Arresto is also NOT the RU вынужденная остановка / UZ majburiy to'xtash: that is sosta di emergenza.

entries.it: Parte della strada destinata normalmente alla circolazione dei veicoli; non comprende marciapiedi, banchine, piste ciclabili e piazzole di sosta. Può essere suddivisa in corsie.
entries.ru: проезжая часть — часть дороги, предназначенная для движения транспортных средств; не включает тротуары, обочины, велодорожки и карманы для стоянки; делится на полосы.
entries.en: carriageway (driving surface) — the part of the road normally used by vehicles; it excludes pavements, verges, cycle paths and lay-bys, and may be divided into lanes.
entries.uz: qatnov qismi — yo'lning transport vositalari harakati uchun mo'ljallangan qismi; piyodalar yo'lkasi, yo'l cheti, velosiped yo'lagi va to'xtash maydonchalarini o'z ichiga olmaydi.
entries.trap: Carreggiata is narrower than strada and wider than corsia. Figure questions count carreggiate and corsie as separate units ('la strada rappresentata è composta da tre carreggiate'), so one RU дорога / UZ yo'l for all three loses the whole quesito.

entries.it: Parte della carreggiata, delimitata da strisce longitudinali continue o discontinue, di larghezza sufficiente a consentire il transito di una sola fila di veicoli.
entries.ru: полоса движения — часть проезжей части, обозначенная продольной разметкой и достаточная для движения одного ряда транспортных средств.
entries.en: lane — a subdivision of the carriageway, bounded by longitudinal lines, wide enough for a single file of vehicles.
entries.uz: harakat yo'lagi — qatnov qismining uzunasiga tortilgan chiziqlar bilan chegaralangan, faqat bitta qator transport vositasi sig'adigan qismi.
entries.trap: A corsia is part OF a carreggiata, never the reverse: 'la corsia è formata da due carreggiate' is FALSE, and so is 'la corsia può essere a doppio senso di circolazione' — a carreggiata can be two-way, a single lane cannot.

entries.it: Regola che stabilisce quale utente deve passare per primo in un punto di conflitto; deriva dalla norma generale (destra), da un segnale o da una segnalazione semaforica.
entries.ru: приоритет / преимущество проезда — правило, определяющее, кто проезжает первым в точке конфликта; вытекает из общей нормы (помеха справа), знака или светофора.
entries.en: priority / right of way — the rule deciding who goes first at a conflict point, set by the general rule (yield to the right), by a sign, or by traffic lights.
entries.uz: yo'ldan foydalanish ustunligi — nizoli nuqtada kim birinchi o'tishini belgilovchi qoida; umumiy qoida (o'ngdagiga), belgi yoki svetofor bilan aniqlanadi.
confusable_with: obbligo di arrestarsi e dare precedenza
entries.trap: Having the diritto di precedenza and having to dare la precedenza are opposite duties built from the same noun, and items swap which side owes it. Note also that 'il diritto di precedenza non autorizza il conducente ad attraversare l'incrocio senza usare prudenza' is TRUE.

entries.it: Obbligo, imposto da norma o da segnale, di consentire il passaggio agli utenti che ne hanno diritto, rallentando e, se necessario, arrestandosi.
entries.ru: уступить дорогу — обязанность пропустить тех, кто имеет приоритет: снизить скорость и при необходимости остановиться, не вынуждая их менять скорость или направление.
entries.en: to give way / to yield — the duty imposed ON YOU to let priority users pass, slowing and if necessary stopping, without forcing them to brake or swerve.
entries.uz: yo'l berish — ustunlikka ega bo'lgan qatnashchilarni o'tkazib yuborish majburiyati: sekinlashtirish, zarur bo'lsa to'xtash.
entries.trap: It is the mirror image of having priority — do not use one gloss for both, or the two versions of an item read identically. DARE PRECEDENZA does not by itself require stopping; only STOP obliges you to arrestarsi and then dare la precedenza.

entries.it: Passaggio di un veicolo o di un utente lungo un tratto di strada; i segnali di divieto lo vietano a categorie determinate di utenti o di veicoli.
entries.ru: проезд / проход (движение через участок) — прохождение транспортного средства или участника по участку дороги; запрещающие знаки закрывают его для определённых категорий.
entries.en: passage / through-travel — a vehicle's or user's movement along a stretch of road; prohibition signs bar it to named categories ('vieta il transito ai…').
entries.uz: o'tish (harakatlanish) — transport vositasi yoki yo'l harakati qatnashchisining yo'l qismidan o'tishi; taqiqlovchi belgilar buni ayrim toifalarga yopadi.
entries.trap: Not 'transit' as in public transport, and not traffic in general. The answer is the category named after 'transito ai/di' — pedoni, ciclisti, autocarri, veicoli a motore — so the noun that follows is what the sign actually bans.

entries.it: Insieme di edifici delimitato lungo le vie di accesso dagli appositi segnali di inizio e di fine; entro di esso valgono limiti e regole proprie (di norma 50 km/h).
entries.ru: населённый пункт — застроенная территория, обозначенная на всех въездах знаками начала и конца; внутри действуют собственные правила и ограничения (обычно 50 км/ч).
entries.en: built-up area — a settlement legally delimited by the entry and exit name signs on every access road; its own limits and rules apply inside (normally 50 km/h).
entries.uz: aholi punkti — kirish yo'llarida boshlanish va tugash belgilari bilan chegaralangan qurilgan hudud; ichida alohida qoidalar amal qiladi (odatda 50 km/soat).
entries.trap: It is a legal boundary set by a sign, not 'the city centre'. Speed, parking, horn and light rules all switch at the segnale di inizio/fine centro abitato — and 50 km/h is 'ordinariamente', not 'sempre'.

entries.it: Entrare e occupare con il proprio veicolo un'area di conflitto (incrocio, passaggio a livello, corsia); è consentito solo se si ha la possibilità di sgomberarla.
entries.ru: въехать / занять (перекрёсток) — выехать на конфликтную зону и занять её; допускается, только если есть возможность её освободить.
entries.en: to enter / occupy (a junction) — to drive onto and take up a conflict area such as a junction, level crossing or lane, permitted only if you can clear it.
entries.uz: kirmoq / egallamoq — chorraha, temiryo'l kesishmasi yoki yo'lakka kirib, uni egallamoq; faqat uni bo'shata olish imkoni bo'lgandagina ruxsat etiladi.
entries.trap: Not 'to engage/commit'. 'Impegnare l'incrocio' means to drive into it — which is why 'giungendo ad un incrocio è consentito impegnarlo solo se si ha la possibilità di proseguire e liberarlo' is TRUE and 'la luce rossa consente di impegnare l'incrocio con prudenza' is FALSE.

entries.it: Manovra con cui il conducente entra nel flusso della circolazione da una strada laterale, da un'area privata o dalla sosta, dando la precedenza a chi già circola.
entries.ru: влиться в поток / выехать на дорогу — манёвр выезда в поток движения со второстепенной дороги, прилегающей территории или со стоянки; обязывает уступить дорогу.
entries.en: to merge / to join the traffic flow — the manoeuvre of entering the stream of traffic from a side road, a private area or a parking spot, yielding to vehicles already circulating.
entries.uz: harakat oqimiga qo'shilish — yon yo'ldan, hovlidan yoki to'xtash joyidan harakat oqimiga chiqish manevri; harakatdagi transportga yo'l berish shart.
entries.trap: A named manoeuvre with its own duty and penalty: 'il mancato rispetto delle norme prescritte per immettersi nel flusso della circolazione comporta la perdita di punti' is TRUE. Doing it in retromarcia obliges you to yield to ALL traffic and to pedestrians behind you.

entries.it: Parte della strada esterna alla carreggiata, posta oltre la linea bianca continua di margine; di norma non consente né il transito né la sosta dei veicoli.
entries.ru: обочина — часть дороги за пределами проезжей части, за сплошной краевой линией; по общему правилу движение по ней и стоянка на ней не допускаются.
entries.en: verge / hard shoulder — the part of the road outside the carriageway, beyond the continuous white edge line; as a rule it is open neither to traffic nor to parking.
entries.uz: yo'l cheti (yelka) — yo'lning qatnov qismidan tashqarida, uzluksiz chekka chizig'i ortida joylashgan qismi; odatda unda harakatlanish ham, to'xtab turish ham mumkin emas.
entries.trap: 'La banchina è parte della carreggiata, destinata alla sosta dei veicoli' is FALSE on both counts — it lies outside the carreggiata and is not a parking place. It is still part of the strada, and it does not divide the carreggiata into lanes.

entries.it: Parte della strada, esterna alla carreggiata, rialzata o delimitata in altro modo, riservata di norma ai pedoni.
entries.ru: тротуар — часть дороги вне проезжей части, приподнятая или иначе выделенная, предназначенная, как правило, для пешеходов.
entries.en: pavement / sidewalk — the part of the road outside the carriageway, raised or otherwise marked off, reserved as a rule for pedestrians.
entries.uz: piyodalar yo'lkasi — yo'lning qatnov qismidan tashqaridagi, ko'tarilgan yoki boshqacha ajratilgan, odatda piyodalarga ajratilgan qismi.
entries.trap: 'Il marciapiede è una parte della carreggiata' is FALSE — it belongs to the strada, not to the carreggiata. It is not open to bicycles, ciclomotori may not park on it, and vehicles may stand there only where parking bays are actually marked.

entries.it: Manovra di superamento di un veicolo in movimento che precede sulla stessa carreggiata, con spostamento dalla propria fila e successivo rientro; si esegue di norma a sinistra.
entries.ru: обгон — манёвр опережения движущегося впереди транспортного средства с выездом из своего ряда и последующим возвратом; выполняется, как правило, слева.
entries.en: overtaking — the manoeuvre of passing a moving vehicle ahead on the same carriageway by leaving your file and returning to it, normally on the left.
entries.uz: quvib o'tish — bir xil qatnov qismida oldinda ketayotgan transport vositasini o'z qatoridan chiqib o'zib o'tish va qaytadan qatorga kirish manevri; odatda chapdan.
entries.trap: Do not gloss it with the same word as superare, and note the geometry decides: sorpasso is banned in curve and on dossi on two-lane two-way roads, but is CONSENTITO in curve and on dossi where the road has separate carriageways with at least two lanes per direction.

entries.it: Ostacolo o rallentamento arrecato alla circolazione altrui; la velocità e le manovre devono essere regolate in modo da non causarlo.
entries.ru: создание помех движению — затруднение или замедление движения других участников; самостоятельное нарушение с собственной санкцией, а не бытовое неудобство.
entries.en: obstruction of traffic — hindering or slowing other road users; a named offence carrying its own sanction, not a vague inconvenience.
entries.uz: harakatga to'sqinlik qilish — boshqa qatnashchilar harakatini qiyinlashtirish yoki sekinlashtirish; o'z jazosiga ega alohida huquqbuzarlik.
entries.trap: Because it is a legal category, the bank lists what does and does not count: gareggiare in velocità, circolare a velocità troppo bassa senza motivo and swinging left to turn right ARE intralcio; merely stopping along the right margin of a one-way carriageway is NOT.

entries.it: Area comune a due o più strade che si incontrano, organizzata per il passaggio dei veicoli; è il termine corrente per intersezione, a raso o a livelli sfalsati.
entries.ru: перекрёсток — общая зона двух и более сходящихся дорог; обиходный синоним intersezione — в одном уровне или в разных уровнях.
entries.en: junction / crossroads — the area shared by two or more roads that meet; the everyday word the bank glosses as intersezione, whether at grade or grade-separated.
entries.uz: chorraha — ikki yoki undan ortiq yo'l tutashadigan umumiy hudud; intersezione so'zining kundalik muqobili, bir sathli yoki turli sathli bo'lishi mumkin.
entries.trap: Incrocio and intersezione name the SAME object — the bank literally prints 'intersezione (incrocio)'. The discriminating detail is always a raso vs a livelli sfalsati, never the noun. A passaggio a livello is not an incrocio.

entries.it: Movimento dei veicoli e degli utenti sulla strada; nella locuzione «carta di circolazione» indica invece il documento che abilita il veicolo a circolare.
entries.ru: дорожное движение — движение транспортных средств и участников по дороге; но в сочетании «carta di circolazione» — регистрационный документ автомобиля.
entries.en: road traffic / road use — the movement of vehicles and users on the road; but in 'carta di circolazione' it instead names the vehicle's registration document.
entries.uz: yo'l harakati — transport vositalari va qatnashchilarning yo'ldagi harakati; «carta di circolazione» birikmasida esa transport vositasining ro'yxatdan o'tganlik guvohnomasi.
entries.trap: Never 'circulation'. Two readings live side by side: 'esigenze della circolazione' means traffic conditions (this is exactly what defines arresto), while the carta di circolazione is a paper stating massa a pieno carico, portata and number of seats.

entries.it: Condizione della strada o della carreggiata sulla quale il traffico si svolge nei due sensi opposti di marcia.
entries.ru: двустороннее движение — режим дороги или проезжей части, по которой транспорт движется в двух противоположных направлениях.
entries.en: two-way traffic — the condition of a road or carriageway carrying traffic in both opposing directions.
entries.uz: ikki tomonlama harakat — yo'l yoki qatnov qismida transportning qarama-qarshi ikki yo'nalishda harakatlanishi.
entries.trap: A strada and a carreggiata may be a doppio senso; a single corsia may NOT — 'la corsia può essere a doppio senso di circolazione' is FALSE. On a two-lane two-way road the phrase alone already forbids sorpasso in curve and on dossi.

entries.it: Condizione della strada o della carreggiata sulla quale la circolazione è consentita in un solo senso di marcia.
entries.ru: одностороннее движение — режим дороги или проезжей части, по которой движение разрешено только в одном направлении.
entries.en: one-way — the condition of a road or carriageway on which traffic may run in one direction only.
entries.uz: bir tomonlama harakat — yo'l yoki qatnov qismida harakat faqat bitta yo'nalishda ruxsat etilishi.
entries.trap: The answer set flips versus doppio senso: on an urban senso unico, sosta is allowed along the LEFT margin too, provided at least one file of vehicles (3 m) can still pass — but 'sempre consentita' is FALSE, and a no-parking sign on one side does not ban parking on the other.

entries.it: Strada extraurbana a carreggiate indipendenti o separate, con almeno due corsie per senso, banchine pavimentate, priva di incroci a raso e di accessi privati.
entries.ru: главная загородная дорога (класс B) — внегородская дорога с раздельными проезжими частями, минимум по две полосы в каждом направлении, без пересечений в одном уровне; синие знаки, 110 км/ч.
entries.en: main extra-urban road (class B) — an out-of-town road with independent or separated carriageways, at least two lanes each way and no at-grade junctions; blue signs, 110 km/h.
entries.uz: asosiy shaharlararo yo'l (B toifa) — qatnov qismlari ajratilgan, har tomonda kamida ikkita yo'lakli, bir sathli kesishmalarsiz shahardan tashqari yo'l; ko'k belgilar, 110 km/soat.
entries.trap: A road class fixed by its own sign, not 'a big road outside town'. Its limit for a car is 110 km/h, not 90 (that is the extraurbana secondaria), it has no incroci a raso crossing it, and sosta is permitted only in the designated areas.

entries.it: Intersezione a raso fra una strada e una linea ferroviaria o tranviaria in sede propria; può essere munito di barriere, di semibarriere o essere privo di barriere.
entries.ru: железнодорожный переезд — пересечение дороги с рельсовым путём в одном уровне; бывает со шлагбаумами, с полушлагбаумами или без них.
entries.en: level crossing — a road crossing a railway or tramway line on its own right of way, at the same level; it may have barriere, semibarriere, or none.
entries.uz: temiryo'l kesishmasi (pereyezd) — yo'l va temiryo'lning bir sathda kesishishi; to'siqli, yarim to'siqli yoki to'siqsiz bo'lishi mumkin.
entries.trap: 'Livello' here is the rail crossing, nothing to do with a floor or storey: a cavalcavia, a sottopassaggio and a passo carrabile are all NOT a passaggio a livello, and an intersezione a raso between two roads is not one either.

entries.it: Manovra con cui il conducente inverte il senso di marcia del veicolo per percorrere la stessa strada in direzione opposta.
entries.ru: разворот — манёвр изменения направления движения на противоположное для движения по той же дороге назад.
entries.en: U-turn — the manoeuvre of reversing your direction of travel so as to drive back along the same road the other way.
entries.uz: burilib qaytish — harakat yo'nalishini qarama-qarshi tomonga o'zgartirib, o'sha yo'ldan orqaga yurish manevri.
entries.trap: Three different things learners merge: inversione (U-turn), retromarcia (reversing) and svolta (turning off). The DIVIETO DI INVERSIONE sign bans only this one manoeuvre, so reading it as 'no turning' or 'no reversing' answers the wrong prohibition.

entries.it: Velocità massima consentita su un dato tipo di strada o tratto, fissata dalla legge o dal segnale; distinta dalla velocità massima per costruzione del veicolo.
entries.ru: максимальная разрешённая скорость — предельная скорость на данном типе дороги или участке, установленная законом или знаком; не конструктивная скорость ТС.
entries.en: maximum speed limit — the highest speed permitted on a given road type or stretch, set by law or by a sign; not the vehicle's design speed.
entries.uz: eng yuqori ruxsat etilgan tezlik — muayyan yo'l turida yoki qismida qonun yoki belgi bilan belgilangan chegara tezlik; transport vositasining konstruktiv tezligi emas.
confusable_with: fine del limite massimo di velocità
entries.trap: Not every 'velocità massima' is the road limit: 'velocità massima per costruzione' defines vehicle classes (a triciclo a motore exceeds 45 km/h by construction). The road owner may also impose a velocità MINIMA obbligatoria on a lane.

entries.it: Interruzione della marcia dovuta all'inutilizzabilità del veicolo per avaria o a esigenze di ordine fisico degli occupanti; in autostrada non può protrarsi oltre tre ore.
entries.ru: вынужденная остановка — прекращение движения из-за неисправности ТС или физического недомогания водителя либо пассажира; на автостраде — не дольше трёх часов.
entries.en: emergency standing / breakdown stop — an interruption of travel because the vehicle is unusable through a fault, or because an occupant is physically unwell; on motorways never beyond three hours.
entries.uz: majburiy to'xtash — transport vositasining nosozligi yoki yo'lovchi/haydovchining jismoniy holati sababli harakatning to'xtatilishi; avtomagistralda uch soatdan oshmasligi kerak.
confusable_with: corsia per la sosta di emergenza
entries.trap: A legally separate FOURTH category. 'La sosta di emergenza è l'interruzione della marcia dovuta ad esigenze della circolazione' is FALSE — that is arresto; and letting a disabled person get in or out is fermata, not sosta di emergenza.

entries.it: Effettuare il sorpasso: oltrepassare un veicolo in movimento che precede sulla stessa carreggiata, spostandosi dalla propria fila e successivamente rientrandovi.
entries.ru: обгонять — совершать обгон: опережать движущееся впереди ТС с выездом из своего ряда и возвращением в него.
entries.en: to overtake — to carry out a sorpasso: to pass a moving vehicle ahead on the same carriageway, pulling out of your file and back into it.
entries.uz: quvib o'tmoq — oldinda ketayotgan transport vositasini o'z qatoridan chiqib o'zib o'tmoq va keyin qatorga qaytmoq.
entries.trap: Sorpassare always takes a VEHICLE as its object; superare in the very same sentence takes a line, an obstacle or a speed. 'Il sorpasso è vietato se si è costretti a superare la linea longitudinale tratteggiata' is FALSE — crossing a broken line in order to overtake is allowed.

entries.it: Oltrepassare un limite, una linea o un ostacolo: eccedere la velocità o la portata consentita, oltrepassare una striscia, aggirare un ostacolo o uno spartitraffico.
entries.ru: превысить / пересечь / объехать — выйти за предел (скорости, грузоподъёмности), пересечь линию разметки или объехать препятствие; это НЕ обгон.
entries.en: to exceed / to cross / to pass round — to go beyond a limit (speed, load), to cross a marked line, or to go round an obstacle or traffic divider; it is NOT overtaking.
entries.uz: oshib ketmoq / kesib o'tmoq / aylanib o'tmoq — chegaradan (tezlik, yuk) oshmoq, chiziqni kesib o'tmoq yoki to'siqni aylanib o'tmoq; bu quvib o'tish EMAS.
entries.trap: Only when the object is a vehicle does superare come close to sorpasso. Everywhere else it means exceed or go round: 'non superare l'ostacolo a destra', 'i veicoli non devono superare la striscia di arresto', 'il carico non deve superare la portata indicata'.

entries.it: Area ad uso pubblico destinata alla circolazione dei pedoni, dei veicoli e degli animali; comprende carreggiate, corsie, banchine, marciapiedi e piste ciclabili.
entries.ru: дорога (в целом) — вся полоса общего пользования для движения пешеходов, транспорта и животных: включает проезжие части, полосы, обочины, тротуары и велодорожки.
entries.en: road (the whole public way) — the public area for the movement of pedestrians, vehicles and animals: carriageways, lanes, verges, pavements and cycle paths taken together.
entries.uz: yo'l (butun bo'yicha) — piyodalar, transport vositalari va hayvonlar harakati uchun umumiy foydalanishdagi hudud: qatnov qismlari, yo'laklar, yo'l chetlari, piyodalar yo'lkalari va velosiped yo'laklarini qamrab oladi.
entries.trap: Strada is the widest of the four: 'la strada può essere suddivisa in carreggiate' and 'la strada può comprendere le piste ciclabili' are TRUE. Using RU дорога / UZ yo'l for carreggiata and corsia as well makes every counting question in a figure unanswerable.

entries.it: Area comune a più strade che si intersecano: a raso se poste allo stesso livello, a livelli sfalsati se a quote diverse, con rampe, sovrappassi o sottopassi.
entries.ru: пересечение (перекрёсток) — общая зона нескольких пересекающихся дорог: в одном уровне (a raso) либо в разных уровнях (a livelli sfalsati) с рампами, эстакадами и тоннелями.
entries.en: intersection — the area shared by roads that cross: a raso when they lie at the same level, a livelli sfalsati when at different heights, with ramps, flyovers or underpasses.
entries.uz: kesishma — kesishuvchi yo'llarning umumiy hududi: bir sathli (a raso) yoki turli sathli (a livelli sfalsati) — rampalar, ustki va ostki o'tish yo'llari bilan.
entries.trap: The traps are built INSIDE the word: 'l'intersezione a livelli sfalsati è un incrocio a raso fra una strada e i binari del treno' is FALSE, an intersezione a raso is neither a passaggio a livello nor a passo carrabile, and a livelli sfalsati is not normally semaforo-controlled.

entries.it: Locuzione che individua il punto esattamente coincidente con il luogo indicato; si contrappone a «in prossimità», che designa la zona circostante.
entries.ru: непосредственно на / в створе — точно в указанном месте, в самой его границе; противопоставляется «in prossimità» (вблизи, в зоне подхода).
entries.en: at / directly at — exactly at the point indicated, on the spot itself, as opposed to 'in prossimità', which is the surrounding approach zone.
entries.uz: aynan shu joyda (ro'parasida) — ko'rsatilgan joyning aynan o'zida; «in prossimità» (yaqinida, yondashuv zonasi) dan farq qiladi.
entries.trap: The bank builds items by affirming one location and denying the other: 'in corrispondenza del passo carrabile è consentita la fermata' is TRUE while the same sentence with la sosta is FALSE — and at intersections the ban covers in corrispondenza AND in prossimità.

entries.it: Locuzione che individua la zona di avvicinamento a un luogo, più ampia della sua esatta corrispondenza e talora quantificata in metri dalla norma.
entries.ru: вблизи / на подъезде — зона приближения к месту, шире, чем сама точка; иногда закон задаёт её в метрах.
entries.en: in the vicinity of / approaching — the approach zone around a place, wider than the exact point, and sometimes fixed in metres by the rule.
entries.uz: yaqinida (yondashuv zonasida) — joyga yaqinlashish hududi; nuqtaning o'zidan kengroq, ba'zan qonunda metrlarda belgilanadi.
entries.trap: It is often quantified: in centri abitati fermata and sosta are banned in corrispondenza of intersections and in prossimità at less than 5 metres, and sosta is banned within 15 metri of a bus-stop sign where no bays are marked. 'in prossimità … a più di 5 metri' is FALSE.

entries.it: Ogni macchina di qualsiasi specie che circola sulle strade guidata dall'uomo: vi rientrano velocipedi, veicoli a trazione animale, ciclomotori, motoveicoli, autoveicoli e rimorchi.
entries.ru: транспортное средство (ТС) — любая управляемая человеком машина, движущаяся по дороге; сюда входят и велосипеды, и прицепы, и гужевые повозки, а не только автомобили.
entries.en: vehicle — any human-guided machine of any kind that travels on the road; the legal umbrella covers bicycles, animal-drawn carts, mopeds, motorcycles, cars and trailers alike.
entries.uz: transport vositasi — yo'lda odam boshqaruvida harakatlanadigan har qanday moslama; velosiped, tirkama va ot-arava ham shu toifaga kiradi, faqat avtomobil emas.
entries.trap: veicolo is NOT 'car'. RU машина/автомобиль and UZ mashina/avtomobil silently narrow it to a car, so a rule written for tutti i veicoli looks like it spares bicycles, trailers and carts — it does not. Use ТС / transport vositasi.

entries.it: Veicolo dotato di motore proprio che ne consente il movimento autonomo: ciclomotori, motocicli, tricicli, quadricicli, autoveicoli e filoveicoli. Non lo sono i velocipedi né i rimorchi.
entries.ru: механическое (моторное) транспортное средство — ТС с собственным двигателем; велосипед и прицеп к нему не относятся, хотя оба являются veicolo.
entries.en: motor vehicle — a vehicle with its own engine that moves under its own power; bicycles and trailers are vehicles but not motor vehicles.
entries.uz: mexanik (motorli) transport vositasi — o'z dvigateli bilan mustaqil harakatlanadigan TV; velosiped va tirkama bunga kirmaydi, garchi ular ham transport vositasi bo'lsa-da.
entries.trap: A prohibition on veicoli a motore does not touch a velocipede; a prohibition on veicoli does. Signs and questions swap the two words deliberately, so translating both as ТС / transport vositasi erases the difference that decides the answer.

entries.it: Veicolo a motore con almeno quattro ruote, esclusi i quadricicli. È la categoria generale che comprende autovetture, autobus, autocarri, autocaravan e autoveicoli per uso speciale.
entries.ru: автотранспортное средство (родовая категория) — механическое ТС не менее чем с четырьмя колёсами, кроме квадрициклов; объединяет легковые, грузовые автомобили и автобусы.
entries.en: motor car category / four-wheeled motor vehicle — the umbrella class of motor vehicles with at least four wheels, quadricycles excluded, containing cars, buses and lorries.
entries.uz: avtotransport vositasi (umumiy toifa) — kamida to'rt g'ildirakli motorli TV, kvadritsikllar bundan mustasno; yengil avtomobil, yuk avtomobili va avtobusni o'z ichiga oladi.
entries.trap: autoveicolo is the genus, autovettura only one species of it. Hence 'l'autocarro è un autoveicolo' is TRUE while 'l'autocarro è un'autovettura' is FALSE. A single RU автомобиль / UZ avtomobil for both makes the two sentences identical. Also: quadricicli and tricicli a motore are NOT autoveicoli.

entries.it: Autoveicolo destinato al trasporto di persone, avente al massimo nove posti compreso quello del conducente.
entries.ru: легковой автомобиль — автотранспортное средство для перевозки людей, не более девяти мест, включая место водителя.
entries.en: passenger car — a motor vehicle for carrying people, with at most nine seats including the driver's.
entries.uz: yengil avtomobil — odam tashishga mo'ljallangan avtotransport vositasi, haydovchi o'rni bilan birga ko'pi bilan to'qqiz o'rinli.
entries.trap: autovettura is a subset, never a synonym of autoveicolo, and 'l'autobus non è un'autovettura' is TRUE. Overtaking-sign items turn on direction: 'consente ad un'autovettura di sorpassare un motociclo' vs 'consente ad un motociclo di sorpassare un'autovettura' are opposite answers. Nine seats INCLUDES the driver — ten is the FALSE variant.

entries.it: Autoveicolo destinato al trasporto di cose e delle persone addette all'uso o al trasporto delle cose stesse.
entries.ru: грузовой автомобиль (грузовик) — автотранспортное средство для перевозки грузов и лиц, обслуживающих этот груз.
entries.en: goods vehicle / lorry, truck — a motor vehicle for carrying goods and the persons employed in handling them.
entries.uz: yuk avtomobili — yuk va shu yukka xizmat qiluvchi shaxslarni tashishga mo'ljallangan avtotransport vositasi.
entries.trap: An autocarro IS an autoveicolo but is NOT an autovettura — 'l'autocarro è un'autovettura' is a FALSE item. The 3.5 t massa complessiva a pieno carico threshold (overtaking ban, retroreflective panels and stripes) applies to autocarri, not to cars, so glossing all three as машина / avtomobil destroys the entire vehicle-classification topic.

entries.it: Veicolo a motore a due ruote, con o senza carrozzetta, di cilindrata superiore a 50 cm3 o con velocità massima per costruzione superiore a 45 km/h.
entries.ru: мотоцикл (в строгом смысле) — двухколёсное МТС с объёмом двигателя свыше 50 см3 или конструктивной скоростью выше 45 км/ч, с коляской или без.
entries.en: motorcycle (strict sense) — a two-wheeled motor vehicle, with or without sidecar, over 50 cm3 or with a design speed above 45 km/h.
entries.uz: mototsikl (aniq huquqiy ma'noda) — ikki g'ildirakli, silindr hajmi 50 sm3 dan ortiq yoki konstruktiv tezligi 45 km/soatdan yuqori motorli TV; aravachali yoki aravachasiz.
entries.trap: 'Il motociclo è un qualunque veicolo a due ruote' is FALSE — a ciclomotore is also two-wheeled but is not a motociclo, and 'tutti i veicoli a motore con tre ruote sono dei motocicli' is FALSE too. Motorway access needs at least 150 cm3, so one blanket RU мотоцикл / UZ mototsikl turns the definition, autostrada and sorpasso items into guesswork.

entries.it: Veicolo a motore a due o tre ruote con motore termico di cilindrata fino a 50 cm3, o elettrico di potenza fino a 4 kW, e velocità massima per costruzione fino a 45 km/h.
entries.ru: мопед — двух- ИЛИ трёхколёсное МТС с ДВС до 50 см3 (или электромотором до 4 кВт) и конструктивной скоростью до 45 км/ч.
entries.en: moped — a two- OR three-wheeled motor vehicle up to 50 cm3 (or 4 kW electric) with a maximum design speed of 45 km/h.
entries.uz: moped — ikki YOKI uch g'ildirakli, silindr hajmi 50 sm3 gacha (yoki 4 kVt gacha elektr) va konstruktiv tezligi 45 km/soatdan oshmaydigan motorli TV.
entries.trap: RU мотоцикл and UZ mototsikl for ciclomotore is wrong: 'i ciclomotori non rientrano nella categoria dei motocicli' is TRUE. Two facts learners lose: a ciclomotore MAY have three wheels ('i ciclomotori non hanno più di due ruote' is FALSE), and it is barred from autostrade and strade extraurbane principali. Quadricicli leggeri are treated as ciclomotori; quadricicli non leggeri are not.

entries.it: Veicolo privo di motore destinato ad essere trainato da un altro veicolo; è leggero il rimorchio di massa complessiva a pieno carico non superiore a 750 kg.
entries.ru: прицеп — безмоторное ТС, предназначенное для буксировки другим ТС; лёгкий прицеп — с полной массой до 750 кг.
entries.en: trailer — an engineless vehicle in its own right, built to be towed by another vehicle; a light trailer has a laden mass up to 750 kg.
entries.uz: tirkama — dvigatelsiz, boshqa transport vositasi tortishi uchun mo'ljallangan mustaqil TV; yengil tirkama — to'la massasi 750 kg gacha.
entries.trap: A rimorchio is itself a veicolo, not an accessory: it has its own revisione and its own retroreflective panels above 3.5 t ('i rimorchi devono essere sottoposti a revisione periodica insieme al veicolo trainante' is FALSE). Note the pair: a caravan (roulotte) IS a rimorchio, an autocaravan (camper) is NOT. Towing one lowers the speed limits (80 km/h on autostrada).

entries.it: Operazione con cui un veicolo ne trascina un altro, o un rimorchio, tramite gli organi di traino; in autostrada il traino di veicoli in avaria spetta ai soli veicoli di soccorso autorizzati.
entries.ru: буксировка (само действие) — перемещение одним ТС другого ТС или прицепа через тягово-сцепное устройство (gancio/organi di traino).
entries.en: towing (the act) — one vehicle pulling another vehicle or a trailer by means of the coupling gear (tow hitch).
entries.uz: shatakka olish, tirkab tortish (harakatning o'zi) — bir transport vositasining boshqasini yoki tirkamani ilgak (gancio di traino) orqali tortishi.
entries.trap: traino is the ACT, rimorchio is the towed THING — 'gancio di traino' is a tow hitch, not a trailer. Two separate rules get mixed up: towing a rimorchio on the motorway is normal, but towing a broken-down vehicle there is reserved to authorised recovery vehicles. Emergency towing always needs a solid, clearly signalled link (rope, chain, cable, rigid bar).

entries.it: Massa massima del veicolo carico ammessa in circolazione, indicata nella carta di circolazione; corrisponde alla tara aumentata della portata.
entries.ru: разрешённая максимальная (полная) масса — предельная масса гружёного ТС, указанная в carta di circolazione; равна снаряжённой массе (tara) плюс грузоподъёмность (portata).
entries.en: maximum laden mass / gross vehicle mass — the highest permitted mass of the loaded vehicle as stated on the registration document; kerb weight (tara) plus payload (portata).
entries.uz: to'la yuklangan holdagi ruxsat etilgan maksimal (umumiy) massa — texnik pasportda (carta di circolazione) ko'rsatilgan eng katta massa; o'z massasi (tara) va yuk ko'tarish me'yori (portata) yig'indisi.
entries.trap: This is a documented figure, not today's actual weight: the 3,5 t and 6,5 t sign thresholds are read off the carta di circolazione. It is NOT portata (payload only), NOT tara (empty weight) and NOT a vague peso. A generic RU вес / UZ og'irlik gloss leaves the learner unable to say which number the sign means.

entries.it: Il complesso delle cose trasportate dal veicolo; non deve superare la portata indicata nella carta di circolazione e va sistemato in modo da non cadere, sporgere o ridurre la visibilità.
entries.ru: груз (перевозимый) — совокупность перевозимых вещей; не должен превышать portata, указанную в carta di circolazione, и должен быть закреплён.
entries.en: load — the goods actually carried; it must not exceed the payload (portata) shown on the registration document and must be secured so it cannot fall, protrude or block vision.
entries.uz: yuk (tashilayotgan yuk) — transport vositasida tashilayotgan narsalar majmui; texnik pasportdagi portata dan oshmasligi va mahkam joylanishi kerak.
entries.trap: Four different words collapse into one in RU/UZ: carico = the goods on board, portata = the maximum payload allowed, tara = the empty vehicle, massa complessiva a pieno carico = the two added together. Note also the second sense: 'operazioni di carico e scarico' is loading/unloading, not the load itself. There is no 10% tolerance on portata — that variant is FALSE.

entries.it: Lampada luminosa del cruscotto che segnala il funzionamento di un dispositivo o un'anomalia: rossa indica pericolo o guasto grave, verde un dispositivo inserito, blu i proiettori abbaglianti.
entries.ru: контрольная лампа на панели приборов — сигнализирует работу устройства или неисправность: красная — опасность/серьёзная поломка, зелёная — устройство включено, синяя — дальний свет.
entries.en: warning light / telltale on the dashboard — shows that a device is on or that something is wrong: red means danger or a serious fault, green a device switched on, blue the main beam.
entries.uz: nazorat chirog'i (asboblar panelidagi indikator) — qurilma ishlayotganini yoki nosozlikni bildiradi: qizil — xavf yoki jiddiy nosozlik, yashil — qurilma yoqilgan, ko'k — uzoq nur.
entries.trap: spia is NOT 'spy' and NOT a headlamp — it is the little lamp on the dashboard. RU лампа фары / UZ fara chirog'i is wrong. The tested fact is the colour code: red (oil pressure, coolant temperature, handbrake, seat belt, battery, hazard lights) means stop; green means the device is simply on (dipped beams, position lights, flashing indicator); blue is reserved for the abbaglianti.

entries.it: Proiettori con fascio luminoso orientato verso il basso, che illuminano senza abbagliare; obbligatori di notte, in galleria e di giorno su autostrade e strade extraurbane principali.
entries.ru: фары ближнего света — фары с пучком, направленным вниз, чтобы не слепить встречных; обязательны ночью, в туннеле и днём вне населённых пунктов.
entries.en: dipped beam / low beam headlights — headlamps whose beam is aimed downwards so it lights the road without dazzling; compulsory at night, in tunnels and by day outside built-up areas.
entries.uz: yaqin nur faralari — nuri pastga yo'naltirilgan, ko'zni qamashtirmasdan yo'lni yorituvchi faralar; kechasi, tunnelda va kunduzi shahardan tashqarida majburiy.
entries.trap: The prefix ana- reverses the word: abbaglianti (= proiettori di profondità) are the main beam that DOES dazzle, anabbaglianti are the dipped beam that does not. One letter flips the answer. Also: luci di posizione are never a substitute for anabbaglianti, and luci di marcia diurna replace them only by day on autostrade and strade extraurbane principali.

entries.it: Velocità più elevata che il veicolo può raggiungere per le proprie caratteristiche costruttive, dichiarata in omologazione; distingue il ciclomotore (fino a 45 km/h) dal motociclo.
entries.ru: конструктивная максимальная скорость — скорость, которую ТС способно развить по своей конструкции (по омологации); это признак КАТЕГОРИИ ТС, а не ограничение скорости.
entries.en: maximum design speed — the top speed the vehicle is built and type-approved to reach; it is a classification property of the vehicle, not a limit the driver must obey.
entries.uz: konstruktiv maksimal tezlik — transport vositasi o'z tuzilishi bo'yicha erisha oladigan eng yuqori tezlik; bu tezlik CHEKLOVI emas, balki TV toifasining belgisi.
entries.trap: Not a speed limit. 45 km/h per costruzione separates a ciclomotore from a motociclo or triciclo a motore, and an autovettura unable to reach 80 km/h in piano per costruzione is banned from autostrade and strade extraurbane principali. Reading it as limite massimo di velocità turns a vehicle-category question into a speed question and reverses the answer.

entries.it: Verifica periodica dell'idoneità alla circolazione e delle emissioni del veicolo: la prima dopo quattro anni dalla prima immatricolazione, successivamente ogni due anni.
entries.ru: периодический техосмотр транспортного средства — проверка пригодности ТС к эксплуатации: впервые через четыре года после первой регистрации, далее каждые два года.
entries.en: periodic roadworthiness inspection (MOT-style test) — the vehicle's scheduled check: first four years after first registration, then every two years.
entries.uz: transport vositasining davriy texnik ko'rigi — TVning yo'lda yurishga yaroqliligini tekshirish: birinchi marta ro'yxatdan o'tgandan to'rt yil keyin, so'ngra har ikki yilda.
entries.trap: The same word revisione has two unrelated senses in the bank. revisione periodica = the VEHICLE's inspection (4 years, then every 2 — 'ogni cinque anni' is FALSE). revisione della patente = a re-examination of the DRIVER, ordered by the Motorizzazione or the Prefetto when fitness is in doubt or the points hit zero, and failing it means revoca. Answering one with the other's knowledge fails both.

entries.it: Complesso di molle e ammortizzatori che collega il telaio alle ruote, assorbe le irregolarità del fondo stradale e concorre alla tenuta di strada del veicolo.
entries.ru: подвеска автомобиля — совокупность пружин и амортизаторов, соединяющих раму/кузов с колёсами и обеспечивающих сцепление с дорогой.
entries.en: suspension — the springs and dampers linking the chassis to the wheels, absorbing road irregularities and keeping the vehicle's grip.
entries.uz: osma (podveska) — ramani (telaio) g'ildiraklar bilan bog'lovchi prujina va amortizatorlar majmui; yo'l notekisliklarini yumshatadi va yo'l bilan ilashishni ta'minlaydi.
entries.trap: Three different meanings share this word in the bank. Plural sospensioni = the mechanical suspension ('moderare la velocità per evitare danni alle sospensioni'). sospensione della patente = licence suspension, a sanzione accessoria. sospensione della marcia = the temporary halt used in the legal definitions of fermata and sosta. Note also that ammortizzatori (dampers) are a PART of the sospensioni, not an alternative to them.

entries.it: Nel linguaggio assicurativo e del codice, l'incidente stradale da cui derivano danni a persone o a cose; è l'evento che fa sorgere la responsabilità civile e l'obbligo di risarcimento.
entries.ru: ДТП, страховой случай — дорожно-транспортное происшествие, повлёкшее вред людям или имуществу; именно оно порождает гражданскую ответственность и обязанность возместить ущерб. ВНИМАНИЕ: то же слово как прилагательное значит «левый».
entries.en: accident, insurance claim — a road event causing injury to persons or damage to property; it is what gives rise to civil liability and the duty to compensate. NOTE: the same word as an adjective means 'left'.
entries.uz: yo'l-transport hodisasi (YTH), sug'urta hodisasi — odamlarga yoki mol-mulkka zarar yetkazgan yo'l voqeasi; aynan shu fuqarolik javobgarligini va zararni qoplash majburiyatini keltirib chiqaradi. DIQQAT: xuddi shu so'z sifat sifatida 'chap' degani.
entries.trap: Roughly half the occurrences in the bank are the ADJECTIVE 'left' (curva a sinistra, margine sinistro, specchio laterale sinistro) and half the NOUN 'accident' (sinistro stradale). Decide by grammar: 'il/un sinistro stradale' = accident; 'a/di/sul ... sinistro' = left. Reading 'responsabilità penale connessa al sinistro stradale' as anything about the left side destroys the question.

entries.it: Documento che abilita una persona determinata alla guida dei veicoli delle categorie in esso indicate; ha validità a termine ed è confermata previo accertamento dei requisiti psicofisici.
entries.ru: водительское удостоверение — документ, дающий конкретному ЛИЦУ право управлять транспортными средствами указанных в нём категорий; имеет срок действия и подтверждается (conferma) по результатам медицинского освидетельствования.
entries.en: driving licence — the document authorising a specific PERSON to drive vehicles of the categories shown on it; it has a fixed period of validity and is renewed (confermata) after a medical fitness check.
entries.uz: haydovchilik guvohnomasi — muayyan SHAXSGA unda ko'rsatilgan toifadagi transport vositalarini boshqarish huquqini beruvchi hujjat; amal qilish muddati bor va tibbiy ko'rikdan so'ng tasdiqlanadi (conferma).
entries.trap: The patente belongs to the PERSON, the carta di circolazione to the VEHICLE — the bank swaps them constantly. Driving without the carta di circolazione on you does NOT get your patente seized and costs no points; driving with an EXPIRED patente does get it seized on the spot. Also: the patente is confirmed by a medical check, never by a periodic driving test, and the certificato di proprietà need not be shown to officers.

entries.it: Classe di abilitazione riportata sulla patente (AM, A1, A2, A, B1, B, BE...) che individua i veicoli che il titolare può condurre e l'età minima richiesta per conseguirla.
entries.ru: категория (класс допуска) — класс, указанный в водительском удостоверении (AM, A1, A2, A, B1, B, BE...), который определяет, какими транспортными средствами вправе управлять владелец и с какого возраста.
entries.en: licence category (entitlement class) — the class shown on the licence (AM, A1, A2, A, B1, B, BE...) that fixes which vehicles the holder may drive and the minimum age to obtain it.
entries.uz: toifa (kategoriya) — guvohnomada ko'rsatilgan ruxsat sinfi (AM, A1, A2, A, B1, B, BE...); egasi qaysi transport vositalarini va necha yoshdan boshlab boshqarishi mumkinligini belgilaydi.
entries.trap: categoria is a property of the LICENCE, not a class of vehicle. Inclusions run only in the direction the law states: A2 also covers A1 and AM, but holding BE and then obtaining C does NOT give you CE. Categories also do not upgrade with time: A1 does not 'become' A2 after two years.

entries.it: Termine con tre significati distinti: sanzione accessoria che priva temporaneamente della patente; temporanea sospensione della marcia (fermata); organo meccanico posto fra telaio e ruote.
entries.ru: приостановление / прекращение движения / подвеска — одно слово, три несвязанных значения: (1) временное лишение прав как дополнительная санкция, (2) прекращение движения — именно так закон определяет fermata и sosta, (3) подвеска автомобиля (между рамой и колёсами).
entries.en: suspension — one word, three unrelated senses: (1) temporary withdrawal of the licence as an accessory penalty, (2) interruption of the marcia — the legal wording that defines fermata and sosta, (3) the vehicle's mechanical suspension between chassis and wheels.
entries.uz: to'xtatib turish / harakatni to'xtatish / osma (podveska) — bitta so'z, uchta bog'liq bo'lmagan ma'no: (1) guvohnomadan vaqtincha mahrum qilish (qo'shimcha sanksiya), (2) harakatni to'xtatish — qonun fermata va sostani shu so'z bilan ta'riflaydi, (3) avtomobilning osmasi (ramа va g'ildiraklar orasida).
entries.trap: Read the sense off the subject, never off the word alone. 'La sospensione della patente' = penalty. 'La temporanea sospensione della marcia' = the statutory definition of fermata (and, protracted with the driver free to leave, of sosta). 'Le sospensioni' in the plural, fra telaio e ruote, is the mechanical part and has nothing to do with licences.

entries.it: Dotazione iniziale di 20 punti attribuita a ogni patente, decurtata a ogni violazione che ne preveda la sottrazione; l'azzeramento obbliga il titolare alla revisione della patente.
entries.ru: баллы водительского удостоверения — начальный запас 20 баллов, который СПИСЫВАЕТСЯ (sottrazione, perdita, decurtazione) за каждое нарушение, предусматривающее это; обнуление влечёт обязательную переэкзаменовку (revisione).
entries.en: licence points — an initial allowance of 20 points, DEDUCTED (sottrazione, perdita, decurtazione) for each offence that carries a deduction; reaching zero forces the holder to undergo a revisione.
entries.uz: guvohnoma ballari — har bir guvohnomaga dastlab 20 ball beriladi va shuni nazarda tutuvchi har bir qoidabuzarlik uchun AYIRIB TASHLANADI (sottrazione, perdita, decurtazione); ballar nolga tushsa, revisione (qayta imtihon) majburiy bo'ladi.
entries.trap: Points are only ever lost, never earned — the Italian is always sottrazione / perdita / decurtazione di punti. Zero points triggers revisione (a re-test), NOT revoca: 'quando ha esaurito i punti al conducente viene revocata la patente' is FALSE. The initial allowance is 20, not 30. And the split used to build FALSE items is 'sanzione pecuniaria ma non la sottrazione di punti' — a money penalty and a points deduction are separate consequences, not alternatives.

entries.it: Obbligo di risarcire i danni a persone o cose derivanti dal sinistro; grava sul conducente e sul proprietario, è coperta dalla R.C.A. ed è indipendente da quella penale e amministrativa.
entries.ru: гражданская (гражданско-правовая) ответственность — обязанность возместить вред, причинённый ДТП людям И имуществу; лежит одновременно на водителе и на собственнике ТС, покрывается страхованием R.C.A. и не зависит от уголовной и административной ответственности.
entries.en: civil liability — the duty to compensate damage caused by the accident, to persons AND to property; it falls on the driver and the owner alike, is covered by R.C.A. insurance, and is independent of criminal and administrative liability.
entries.uz: fuqarolik javobgarligi — YTH natijasida odamlarga VA mol-mulkka yetkazilgan zararni qoplash majburiyati; haydovchi va transport vositasi egasi zimmasida bo'ladi, R.C.A. sug'urtasi qoplaydi va jinoiy hamda ma'muriy javobgarlikdan mustaqil.
entries.trap: Paying the damages DOES discharge the civil obligation — but it never extinguishes responsabilità penale, and 'si libera da ogni forma di responsabilità penale pagando l'ammontare del danno' is the classic FALSE item. RU ответственность and UZ javobgarlik cover civile, penale and amministrativa with one word, which hides the split. Two more FALSE traps: civil liability is NOT aggravated by having no insurance, and the insurer does NOT pay above the massimali.

entries.it: Contratto obbligatorio per legge (R.C.A.) che copre la responsabilità civile per i danni causati dalla circolazione del veicolo, entro i massimali; il certificato va tenuto a bordo.
entries.ru: страхование, полис (обязательное R.C.A.) — обязательный по закону договор, покрывающий гражданскую ответственность за вред, причинённый движением ТС, в пределах лимитов (massimali); свидетельство о страховании всегда должно быть в автомобиле.
entries.en: insurance (compulsory R.C.A.) — the policy required by law covering civil liability for damage caused by the vehicle's circulation, up to the massimali; the certificate must be kept on board.
entries.uz: sug'urta (majburiy R.C.A.) — transport vositasining harakati natijasida yetkazilgan zarar uchun fuqarolik javobgarligini massimali (limit) doirasida qoplovchi, qonun bo'yicha majburiy shartnoma; sug'urta guvohnomasi doim mashinada bo'lishi shart.
confusable_with: fondo di garanzia per le vittime della strada
entries.trap: R.C.A. attaches to the VEHICLE, not to one particular driver: 'comprende il risarcimento dei danni provocati dal veicolo, purché guidato dal proprietario' is FALSE, and so is 'copre solo la responsabilità del conducente ma non quella del proprietario'. It does NOT cover responsabilità penale, does NOT cover sanzioni amministrative pecuniarie, and does not pay beyond the massimale. Kasko, furto and incendio policies are optional — never compulsory. With R.C.A. expired the vehicle may not be used or even left parked on public roads, and can be confiscated.

entries.it: Documento di circolazione del veicolo, che ne riporta le masse, la portata, il numero di posti e i dati tecnici; senza di essa il veicolo non può circolare. Può essere ritirata.
entries.ru: свидетельство о регистрации ТС (техпаспорт) — документ САМОГО ТРАНСПОРТНОГО СРЕДСТВА: массы, грузоподъёмность, число мест, технические данные; без него ТС не допускается к движению. Может быть изъято (ritiro).
entries.en: vehicle registration document (logbook) — the document of the VEHICLE itself: masses, load capacity, number of seats, technical data; without it the vehicle may not circulate. It can be seized (ritiro).
entries.uz: transport vositasining texnik pasporti (ro'yxatga olish guvohnomasi) — TRANSPORT VOSITASINING o'z hujjati: massalar, yuk ko'tarish qobiliyati, o'rindiqlar soni, texnik ma'lumotlar; usiz transport vositasi harakatlana olmaydi. Olib qo'yilishi (ritiro) mumkin.
