entries.trap: It belongs to the vehicle; the patente belongs to the person. Not having it with you costs NO points and does NOT get your patente seized — but excessive polluting emissions can bring a sanzione amministrativa plus ritiro of the carta di circolazione itself. Also: the number of persons it states DOES include the driver ('non comprende il conducente' is FALSE), and a missing massa rimorchiabile figure means the vehicle may NOT tow, not that it may tow anything.

entries.it: Riesame dell'idoneità del titolare, con visita medica e/o esame di guida, disposto quando sorgono dubbi sui requisiti o a seguito di azzeramento dei punti; non superarlo comporta la revoca.
entries.ru: переосвидетельствование / пересдача (для ВУ) — повторная проверка годности владельца: медосмотр и/или экзамен по вождению, назначаемая при сомнениях в психофизических или технических требованиях либо при обнулении баллов; провал ведёт к аннулированию (revoca). Для ТС — периодический техосмотр.
entries.en: re-examination (of the licence holder) — a fresh check of fitness by medical examination and/or a driving test, ordered when the required physical, mental or technical fitness is in doubt or after points reach zero; failing it leads to revoca. Of a vehicle, it is the periodic roadworthiness test.
entries.uz: qayta tekshiruv / qayta imtihon (guvohnoma uchun) — egasining yaroqliligini qayta tekshirish: tibbiy ko'rik va/yoki haydash imtihoni; talablarga shubha tug'ilganda yoki ballar nolga tushganda buyuriladi; o'ta olmaslik revoca (bekor qilish)ga olib keladi. Transport vositasi uchun esa davriy texnik ko'rik.
entries.trap: Two unrelated revisioni share the word: revisione della PATENTE (re-testing the driver) and revisione periodica del VEICOLO (roadworthiness). Neither is a withdrawal — RU пересдача/проверка must not merge with лишение. It is ordered by the Motorizzazione or the Prefetto, for doubts about fitness, after an accident causing serious injury, and on zero points; it is NOT ordered for permanent loss of fitness (that is revoca) nor for loss of requisiti morali. And you cannot keep driving on a special permit while retaking it: failing the exam means revoca.

entries.it: Sostantivo che nel quesitario ricorre in due soli sensi: il superamento dei limiti di velocità (eccedenza) e il superamento di uno specifico esame (esito positivo).
entries.ru: превышение; сдача (экзамена) — в этом банке вопросов существительное имеет ровно два значения: превышение скоростного ограничения и успешная сдача экзамена. Никогда не «обгон».
entries.en: exceeding; passing (an exam) — in this question bank the noun has exactly two senses: exceeding a speed limit, and successfully passing an exam. It never means overtaking.
entries.uz: oshib ketish (chegaradan); (imtihondan) muvaffaqiyatli o'tish — bu savollar bankida bu ot aynan ikki ma'noga ega: tezlik chegarasidan oshib ketish va imtihondan o'tish. Hech qachon 'quvib o'tish' emas.
entries.trap: The verb superare can mean to overtake, but the NOUN superamento never does in this bank — it appears only twice, in 'il superamento dei limiti di velocità di oltre 10 km/h comporta una perdita di punti' (a speed/points item) and 'il superamento di uno specifico esame' (points recovery). Treating it as a synonym of sorpasso turns a penalty question into an overtaking question and you answer the wrong rule.

entries.it: Conseguenza punitiva della violazione: sanzione amministrativa pecuniaria (somma di denaro) e sanzione accessoria (sospensione, revoca, ritiro, confisca), cui si aggiunge la decurtazione di punti.
entries.ru: санкция, наказание — общий термин, делящийся на административную денежную санкцию (sanzione amministrativa pecuniaria) и дополнительную санкцию (sanzione accessoria: приостановление, аннулирование, изъятие, конфискация); отдельно к ним добавляется списание баллов.
entries.en: penalty, sanction — the umbrella term, splitting into the sanzione amministrativa pecuniaria (a sum of money) and the sanzione accessoria (suspension, revocation, seizure, confiscation); a separate points deduction is added on top.
entries.uz: sanksiya, jazo chorasi — umumiy atama bo'lib, sanzione amministrativa pecuniaria (pul jarimasi) va sanzione accessoria (to'xtatib turish, bekor qilish, olib qo'yish, musodara)ga bo'linadi; ularga alohida ravishda ball ayirish qo'shiladi.
entries.trap: multa, ammenda and contravvenzione occur ZERO times in the 7106 questions — a learner who studies those street words is studying vocabulary the exam never uses. Learn sanzione amministrativa pecuniaria and sanzione accessoria instead. Items are built by asserting one branch and denying the other: 'comporta una sanzione pecuniaria, ma non la sottrazione di punti' is the standard FALSE construction, because both apply together.

entries.it: Provvedimento che annulla definitivamente la patente: perdita permanente dei requisiti psicofisici, guida con patente sospesa, esito negativo dell'esame di revisione. Non la dispone la polizia.
entries.ru: аннулирование, лишение навсегда — окончательная отмена водительского удостоверения: постоянная (навсегда) утрата физических или психических требований, управление при уже приостановленном ВУ, отрицательный результат экзамена revisione. Полиция его не выносит.
entries.en: revocation — permanent cancellation of the licence: permanent loss of the physical or mental requirements, driving while the licence is already suspended, or failing the revisione examination. It is not ordered by the police.
entries.uz: bekor qilish (butunlay mahrum qilish) — guvohnomani doimiy ravishda bekor qilish: jismoniy yoki ruhiy talablarni butunlay yo'qotish, allaqachon to'xtatib turilgan guvohnoma bilan haydash, revisione imtihonidan o'ta olmaslik. Buni politsiya chiqarmaydi.
entries.trap: RU лишение and UZ mahrum qilish swallow sospensione and ritiro as well, and the FALSE options are built exactly on that swap. revoca is permanent: it is NOT for an expired licence (that is ritiro), NOT for driving without the card on you, NOT for temporary loss of fitness (that is sospensione territory), and NOT the automatic consequence of zero points (that is revisione). Note the one asymmetry to memorise: driving WITH a suspended licence is revoca, not a further sospensione.

entries.it: Sanzione accessoria che priva temporaneamente della patente: guida in stato di ebbrezza, rifiuto degli accertamenti, superamento dei limiti di oltre 40 km/h, fuga senza prestare soccorso.
entries.ru: приостановление действия водительского удостоверения — ВРЕМЕННАЯ дополнительная санкция (sanzione accessoria): управление в состоянии опьянения, отказ от освидетельствования, превышение скорости более чем на 40 км/ч, бегство с места ДТП без оказания помощи.
entries.en: licence suspension — a TEMPORARY accessory penalty (sanzione accessoria): drink-driving, refusing the alcohol test, exceeding speed limits by over 40 km/h, fleeing without stopping to give assistance.
entries.uz: guvohnomani vaqtincha to'xtatib turish — VAQTINCHALIK qo'shimcha sanksiya (sanzione accessoria): mast holda haydash, tekshiruvdan bosh tortish, tezlik chegarasidan 40 km/soatdan ortiq oshirish, jabrlanuvchiga yordam bermay qochib ketish.
entries.trap: 'La sospensione della patente è disposta quando il conducente circola con patente sospesa' is FALSE — that case is revoca. It is also NOT ordered on zeroing your points (that is revisione), NOT for definitive loss of physical requirements (revoca), NOT for merely driving without the card on you, and NOT for parking in a disabled bay or missing the car tax. Because it is temporary, it must never be glossed with the same word as revoca.

entries.it: Prelievo materiale del documento da parte degli organi di polizia durante la circolazione; precede l'eventuale provvedimento di sospensione o revoca e riguarda anche la carta di circolazione.
entries.ru: изъятие документа на месте — физическое изъятие документа сотрудником полиции во время движения; это лишь процедурный шаг, ПРЕДШЕСТВУЮЩИЙ последующему решению о приостановлении или аннулировании, и применяется также к техпаспорту.
entries.en: seizure of the document — the officer physically taking the document on the spot during circulation; it is only the procedural step that PRECEDES a later sospensione or revoca, and it applies to the carta di circolazione too.
entries.uz: hujjatni joyida olib qo'yish — politsiya xodimi tomonidan harakat paytida hujjatni jismonan olib qo'yish; bu keyinchalik chiqariladigan to'xtatib turish yoki bekor qilish qaroridan OLDIN keladigan tartib-qoida bosqichi bo'lib, texnik pasportga ham tegishli.
entries.trap: RU изъятие blurs into лишение, hiding that ritiro by itself decides nothing — the sospensione or revoca is decided afterwards by the competent authority. Grounds that DO trigger immediate ritiro: an offence carrying the accessory penalty of sospensione, an expired licence, drink-driving, an accident causing injury, badly stowed load left uncorrected, failing to sit an ordered revisione. Grounds that do NOT: any deduction of points, not carrying the carta di circolazione or the certificato di proprietà, wrong-sized tyres.

entries.it: Responsabilità che sorge solo quando il fatto costituisce reato (lesioni gravi, omicidio colposo); non si estingue con il risarcimento del danno né con l'intervento dell'impresa assicuratrice.
entries.ru: уголовная ответственность — возникает ТОЛЬКО когда деяние является преступлением (reato: тяжкий вред здоровью, причинение смерти по неосторожности); не погашается ни возмещением вреда, ни выплатой страховой компании.
entries.en: criminal liability — arises ONLY where the act constitutes a reato (serious injury, negligent homicide); it is not extinguished by paying compensation nor by the insurer stepping in to pay the victim.
entries.uz: jinoiy javobgarlik — FAQAT qilmish jinoyat (reato) bo'lganda yuzaga keladi (og'ir tan jarohati, ehtiyotsizlik oqibatida o'lim); zararni qoplash yoki sug'urta kompaniyasining to'lovi bilan bekor bo'lmaydi.
entries.trap: The exam repeatedly offers FALSE escapes: it is 'excluded' because you helped the victim, because you paid the damages, or because the insurer compensated — all three are FALSE. It IS genuinely excluded when the damage is to property only, when the act is not a reato, or in cases of force majeure. It is not triggered by every breach of the Codice della Strada, only by conduct that is a crime. R.C.A. never covers it, and R.C.A. does not cover sanzioni amministrative pecuniarie either.

entries.it: Distanza che il conducente deve mantenere dal veicolo che precede, tale da garantire l'arresto tempestivo ed evitare collisioni; non è mai inferiore allo spazio percorso nel tempo di reazione.
entries.ru: дистанция безопасности — расстояние до идущего впереди транспортного средства, которое водитель обязан СОХРАНЯТЬ; оно не может быть меньше пути, пройденного за время реакции, и увеличивается при дожде, снеге, спуске, грузе и износе тормозов.
entries.en: safe following distance — the gap the driver must KEEP from the vehicle ahead; it can never be less than the distance covered during the reaction time, and must be increased for rain, snow, load and descent.
entries.uz: xavfsizlik masofasi — oldinda ketayotgan transport vositasidan haydovchi SAQLASHI shart bo'lgan masofa; u reaksiya vaqtida bosib o'tilgan masofadan kam bo'la olmaydi va yomg'ir, qor, nishablik, yuk hamda tormoz holatiga qarab oshiriladi.
entries.trap: It is the gap you KEEP, not a distance the car travels. Its floor is the reaction-time distance ('può essere inferiore allo spazio percorso nel tempo di reazione' = FALSE), and it is NOT required to equal the braking distance ('almeno pari a quello della distanza di frenatura' = FALSE, 'sempre uguale allo spazio di frenatura' = FALSE). It has no fixed metre value: '100 metri in caso di nevicata/forte pioggia/forti discese' are all FALSE. Sign items reading 'il conducente deve diminuire la distanza di sicurezza' are FALSE.

entries.it: Utente della strada che circola a piedi; rientra fra gli utenti deboli, ai quali il conducente deve dare la precedenza sugli attraversamenti pedonali e usare particolare prudenza.
entries.ru: пешеход — участник дорожного движения, передвигающийся пешком; относится к уязвимым участникам (utenti deboli), которым водитель обязан уступать дорогу на переходе и проявлять особую осторожность.
entries.en: pedestrian — a road user travelling on foot; one of the 'utenti deboli' (vulnerable users) to whom the driver owes priority at crossings and heightened care.
entries.uz: piyoda — yo'lda piyoda harakatlanuvchi ishtirokchi; himoyaga muhtoj ishtirokchilar (utenti deboli) qatoriga kiradi, haydovchi o'tish joyida unga yo'l berishi va alohida ehtiyotkorlik qilishi shart.
entries.trap: Pedone is the PERSON; attraversamento pedonale / strisce pedonali is the place and marciapiede is the pavement — a Russian or Uzbek reader who reads 'pedonale' as 'pedestrian' loses which one the item is asking about. The duty is conditional, and the conditions are the exam: on the strisce you must give way, but a blind pedestrian with the bastone bianco (or a deafblind one with the bastone bianco-rosso) must be given precedenza and helped even OUTSIDE the strisce, with or without a guide dog. Any answer limiting the duty to the strisce, to daytime, to one crossing direction, or to pedestrians within 100 m of a crossing is FALSE.

entries.it: Dovere generale di cautela imposto a ogni utente della strada: comportarsi in modo da non costituire pericolo o intralcio; sussiste anche quando si ha il diritto di precedenza.
entries.ru: осторожность, должная осмотрительность — общая правовая обязанность вести себя так, чтобы не создавать опасности или помех; сохраняется и тогда, когда у вас есть преимущество (precedenza).
entries.en: care, prudence — the standing legal duty of care on every road user to behave so as not to create danger or obstruction; it applies even when you hold right of way.
entries.uz: ehtiyotkorlik — har bir yo'l harakati ishtirokchisiga yuklangan umumiy huquqiy majburiyat: xavf yoki to'siq yaratmaydigan tarzda harakatlanish; ustunlik huquqi (precedenza) bo'lganda ham saqlanib qoladi.
entries.trap: Prudenza is not politeness, courtesy or a recommendation — it is a duty that never switches off. 'Il diritto di precedenza non autorizza il conducente ad attraversare l'incrocio senza usare prudenza' is TRUE; any statement letting you drop prudenza because you have precedenza is FALSE. Conversely, prudenza does not create a permission: 'nelle aree pedonali possono transitare tutti gli autoveicoli, ma con prudenza' and 'la luce rossa consente di svoltare a destra con prudenza' are both FALSE — adding 'con prudenza' never legalises a prohibited manoeuvre.

entries.it: Evento della circolazione che coinvolge veicoli o persone e produce danni o lesioni; obbliga il conducente a fermarsi, a prestare assistenza ai feriti e a non alterare le tracce.
entries.ru: ДТП, дорожная авария (не «инцидент») — происшествие в дорожном движении с ущербом или пострадавшими; водитель обязан остановиться, оказать помощь раненым и не изменять следы происшествия.
entries.en: road accident, crash (NOT an 'incident') — a traffic event causing damage or injury; the driver involved must stop, give assistance to the injured and not disturb the evidence.
entries.uz: yo'l-transport hodisasi, avariya ('insident' emas) — zarar yoki jarohat keltirib chiqaradigan yo'l harakati hodisasi; haydovchi to'xtashi, jarohatlanganlarga yordam ko'rsatishi va izlarni o'zgartirmasligi shart.
entries.trap: False friend. Italian incidente = a crash with real consequences; RU инцидент and EN 'incident' both understate it into 'a minor occurrence' and destroy the severity the article turns on. In the Codice it is interchangeable with sinistro stradale — the same duties attach. Beware also the narrowing traps: assistance is owed regardless of how serious YOU judge the crash to be ('solo se si considera grave l'incidente' = FALSE), and waiting passively for the ambulance without doing anything is FALSE.

entries.it: Spazio percorso dal veicolo dall'inizio della frenata all'arresto; cresce con il quadrato della velocità e aumenta se l'aderenza è scarsa o la strada è in discesa.
entries.ru: путь торможения (только тормозной участок) — расстояние, пройденное с момента начала торможения до полной остановки; растёт пропорционально квадрату скорости.
entries.en: braking distance — the distance covered from the moment braking begins until the vehicle stops; it grows with the SQUARE of the speed.
entries.uz: tormozlash masofasi — tormozlash boshlangan paytdan transport vositasi to'liq to'xtaguncha bosib o'tilgan masofa; tezlik KVADRATIGA mutanosib ravishda ortadi.
entries.trap: It EXCLUDES the distance covered during the tempo di reazione — that part belongs only to the spazio totale di arresto. The arithmetic is quadratic, not linear: double the speed and it QUADRUPLES ('si raddoppia se la velocità si raddoppia' = FALSE, 'si quadruplica' = TRUE; ×3 → nine times, ×4 → sixteen times). Quick reflexes shorten the reaction distance, never the spazio di frenatura ('diminuisce se il conducente ha i riflessi pronti' = FALSE). Uphill it shortens, downhill it lengthens.

entries.it: Attrito che si sviluppa fra pneumatico e pavimentazione stradale; se il coefficiente di aderenza diminuisce, aumentano lo spazio di frenatura e il rischio di slittamento.
entries.ru: сцепление шин с дорогой (не «приверженность», не «соблюдение») — трение между шиной и покрытием; при снижении коэффициента сцепления тормозной путь растёт, а риск заноса и пробуксовки увеличивается.
entries.en: tyre grip, road adhesion (NOT 'adherence' or 'compliance') — the friction between tyre and road surface; when the coefficient of grip falls, braking distance and the risk of skidding both rise.
entries.uz: g'ildirakning yo'lga ilashishi — shina bilan yo'l qoplamasi orasidagi ishqalanish; ilashish koeffitsienti pasayganda tormozlash masofasi uzayadi va sirpanish xavfi ortadi.
entries.trap: Never render it as 'adherence/compliance' (RU «соблюдение», «приверженность»): it is physical grip. It is the causal hinge of the whole safety topic — rain, snow, mud, ice, painted horizontal markings, tram/railway rails and worn pneumatici all lower it, and a lower coefficient then lengthens the spazio di frenatura, makes hard braking dangerous and caps safe cornering speed. Note the direction traps: low grip INCREASES skidding and braking distance; statements saying it reduces them are FALSE. And on a slippery surface you must not stamp the brake pedal to the floor to 'get grip' — that is FALSE.

entries.it: Dispositivo di ritenuta omologato che trattiene il corpo al sedile in caso d'urto; il conducente deve indossarla e accertarsi che sia allacciata anche dai passeggeri.
entries.ru: ремень безопасности — сертифицированное удерживающее устройство, прижимающее тело к сиденью при ударе; водитель обязан пристегнуться сам и убедиться, что пристёгнуты пассажиры.
entries.en: seat belt — a type-approved restraint that holds the body against the seat in a violent impact; the driver must wear one and must check that the passengers have fastened theirs.
entries.uz: xavfsizlik kamari — zarba paytida tanani o'rindiqda ushlab turuvchi, omologatsiyadan o'tgan qurilma; haydovchi o'zi taqishi va yo'lovchilar ham taqqanini tekshirishi shart.
entries.trap: The duty is the DRIVER's for the passengers too — 'bisogna controllare che i passeggeri abbiano regolarmente allacciato le cinture' is TRUE. Do not blur it with the child sistemi di ritenuta: swapping a child's restraint for the adult belt is a distinct rule with its own height threshold, and the item offering '1,30 metri' is FALSE. The airbag works WITH the belt, never instead of it. All the 'exemption' shortcuts are FALSE — short trips, under 30 km/h, urban driving, age over 65/70, obesity aids that hold the belt off the body; the genuine exemptions are narrow and certified (documented illness, certified at-risk pregnancy) or professional (driving instructors while instructing).

entries.it: Casco protettivo omologato, da indossare e allacciare durante la marcia sui ciclomotori, sui motocicli e sui veicoli a manubrio privi di cellula di sicurezza e di sistemi di ritenuta.
entries.ru: защитный шлем — сертифицированный шлем, который в движении обязаны носить и застёгивать водитель и пассажир мопедов, мотоциклов и иных ТС с рулём-мотоциклетного типа без защитной капсулы и ремней.
entries.en: crash helmet — a type-approved protective helmet, worn and fastened while riding on mopeds, motorcycles and any handlebar vehicle lacking a safety cell and restraint systems.
entries.uz: himoya dubulg'asi — omologatsiyadan o'tgan dubulg'a; mopedlar, mototsikllar va xavfsizlik kabinasi hamda tutib turuvchi tizimlari bo'lmagan, manubrio (dastali rul) bilan boshqariladigan transport vositalarida harakat davomida kiyilib, bog'lanishi shart.
entries.trap: The obligation follows the vehicle's CONFIGURATION, not its name. A quadriciclo a manubrio con carrozzeria aperta (Quad) still requires the casco — 'possono essere condotti senza casco' is FALSE — while a quadriciclo with a closed body, safety cell and belts does not, so 'obbligatorio su qualunque quadriciclo a motore' is also FALSE. It binds the passenger as well as the rider, adult or not, and it must be fastened BEFORE moving off from the kerb, not after. None of these are exemptions: short trips, low speed, 30 km/h zones, hot weather, being of age, holding a category B licence, years of experience.

entries.it: Denominazione formale dell'incidente stradale; ne derivano la responsabilità civile di risarcire i danni a persone e cose e, se il fatto costituisce reato, quella penale.
entries.ru: ДТП, дорожно-транспортное происшествие — официальный термин Кодекса для аварии (НЕ «левый»); влечёт гражданскую ответственность за возмещение вреда людям и имуществу и, если деяние является преступлением, уголовную.
entries.en: road traffic accident (the Code's formal term) — NOT 'left'; it gives rise to civil liability to compensate damage to persons and property and, where the act amounts to a crime, to criminal liability.
entries.uz: yo'l-transport hodisasi (YTH) — kodeksdagi rasmiy atama, 'chap' degani EMAS; odamlarga va mol-mulkka yetkazilgan zararni qoplash bo'yicha fuqarolik javobgarligini, qilmish jinoyat bo'lsa esa jinoiy javobgarlikni keltirib chiqaradi.
confusable_with: sinistro (aggettivo: sinistra, lato sinistro, margine sinistro, corsia di sinistra)
entries.trap: Pure homonym, and the wrong sense is the commoner one in this bank: as a NOUN sinistro means a crash; as an ADJECTIVE it means LEFT (margine sinistro, corsia di sinistra, retrovisore sinistro, curva a sinistra). Read the grammar — 'un sinistro / del sinistro' = an accident, 'a sinistra / il lato sinistro' = left. A learner locked on 'left' mis-parses every liability item. Then keep the two liabilities apart: paying the damages extinguishes the CIVIL obligation but never the criminal one, and insurance settling the claim does not exclude criminal responsibility.

entries.it: Somma dello spazio percorso durante il tempo di reazione e dello spazio di frenatura; dipende dalla velocità, dalle condizioni dell'asfalto e dall'usura dei pneumatici.
entries.ru: полный остановочный путь — сумма пути, пройденного за время реакции, И тормозного пути; зависит от скорости, состояния покрытия и износа шин.
entries.en: total stopping distance — reaction distance PLUS braking distance; it depends on speed, road surface condition and tyre wear.
entries.uz: to'liq to'xtash masofasi — reaksiya vaqtida bosib o'tilgan masofa VA tormozlash masofasi yig'indisi; tezlikka, yo'l qoplamasi holatiga hamda shinalarning yeyilishiga bog'liq.
entries.trap: It is the SUM of two components: statements equating it with the reaction distance alone, or with the braking distance alone, are both FALSE. RU тормозной путь and UZ to'xtash masofasi are used loosely for either component, so mark the total one explicitly — полный остановочный путь / to'liq to'xtash masofasi — and reserve тормозной путь / tormozlash masofasi for spazio di frenatura. Direction traps: it grows with speed, snow, mud and worn tyres; rough (ruvido) asphalt and unworn tyres SHORTEN it, so items claiming otherwise are FALSE.

entries.it: Proiettori a luce anabbagliante, orientati in basso per non abbagliare; obbligatori di notte, in galleria, con scarsa visibilità e, anche di giorno, fuori dei centri abitati.
entries.ru: ближний свет (фары ближнего света) — свет, направленный вниз, чтобы не слепить встречных; обязателен ночью, в туннеле, при плохой видимости и ДНЁМ вне населённых пунктов, на автомагистралях и главных загородных дорогах.
entries.en: dipped beams, low beams — headlamps aimed downwards so as not to dazzle; compulsory at night, in tunnels, in poor visibility and, by day as well, outside built-up areas including motorways and main extra-urban roads.
entries.uz: yaqin nur (yaqin nurli faralar) — ko'zni qamashtirmaslik uchun pastga yo'naltirilgan nur; kechasi, tunnelda, ko'rish yomonlashganda hamda aholi punktlaridan tashqarida, avtomagistral va asosiy shaharlararo yo'llarda KUNDUZI ham yoqilishi shart.
entries.trap: Two letters change the meaning completely: anabbaglianti = dipped / ближний свет / yaqin nur, abbaglianti = main / дальний свет / uzoq nur. English 'headlights' flattens both and the compulsory-use items become unreadable. Daytime use outside built-up areas is mandatory, not optional — 'facoltativo in condizioni di perfetta visibilità' is FALSE — and it is required in tunnels whether or not they are lit. Luci di posizione are never an acceptable alternative to them. Note also that badly aimed anabbaglianti can still dazzle, which is why 'proiettori anabbaglianti male orientati possono abbagliare' is TRUE.

entries.it: Proiettori a luce abbagliante (di profondità); vietati di norma nei centri abitati e da sostituire con gli anabbaglianti quando si incrociano o si seguono da vicino altri veicoli.
entries.ru: дальний свет (фары дальнего света, proiettori di profondità) — как правило запрещён в населённых пунктах; при встречном разъезде и при движении близко за другим ТС его обязательно переключают на ближний.
entries.en: main beams, high beams (also 'proiettori di profondità') — normally banned inside built-up areas and must be switched to dipped beams when meeting oncoming vehicles or following another vehicle closely.
entries.uz: uzoq nur (uzoq nurli faralar, proiettori di profondità) — odatda aholi punktlarida taqiqlanadi; qarama-qarshi transport bilan uchrashganda yoki oldindagi transport ortidan yaqin borganda albatta yaqin nurga o'tkaziladi.
entries.trap: abbaglianti = MAIN beams (дальний / uzoq nur); anabbaglianti = the dipped ones (ближний / yaqin nur). Merged in the learner's head, a sentence containing both words becomes unparseable — you cannot tell who is dazzling whom. Note that 'proiettori di profondità' is the same thing under another name. They are lawful outside built-up areas only where public lighting is missing or insufficient AND you are not meeting other traffic; they are not a night-time obligation, not a way to be seen, and not a hazard signal. When someone dazzles you, the answer is slow down, keep your lane and use your own anabbaglianti — never retaliate with abbaglianti. The brief intermittent lampeggio is a separate, permitted use (to signal an overtake, even in town, or to warn of danger), not a licence to drive on main beam.

problems.problem: The trap's central claim is contradicted by the bank. It says indica is "here-and-now", "the verb of mandatory, prohibitory and indication signs", and that "'Il segnale raffigurato indica una curva pericolosa a destra' is FALSE" while preannuncia is TRUE — presented as a pairing "on the SAME sign". None of that holds: (a) danger signs take indica with TRUE answers — q18852 'Il segnale raffigurato indica un tratto di strada deformata lungo 380 metri' [TRUE], q19343 'indica che, poco oltre, occorrerà usare maggiore prudenza' [TRUE], q19458 'indica che ci si sta avvicinando ad un bosco facilmente infiammabile' [TRUE], q19501 'indica che bisogna moderare la velocità' [TRUE], all in topic 'Segnali di pericolo'; (b) the quoted pair is on two DIFFERENT signs — q20066 'indica l'obbligo di svoltare a sinistra' [TRUE] has image 0e5e82c068555fe2.jpeg, q20143 'preannuncia l'obbligo di svoltare a sinistra' [FALSE] has image 79fb6bac47fe4142.jpeg (a preavviso-di-direzione-obbligatoria-a-destra sign — it is FALSE because of the DIRECTION, not the verb); (c) on the genuine preavviso-a-sinistra sign (bd0d03694ad85fcd.jpeg) q20146 'preannuncia l'obbligo di svoltare a sinistra al prossimo incrocio' is TRUE. On image 464643331ebd9e6c.jpeg BOTH q20232 (preannuncia) and q20239 (indica) are FALSE. A learner taught this rule will answer q18852/q19343/q19458/q19501 wrong.
problems.correction: Do not teach a verb-decides-the-answer rule. indica = states what the sign means/what is there (usable for danger signs too: 'indica un tratto di strada deformata'); preannuncia = announces something met further on. The truth value in the bank is decided by the CONTENT (which sign, which direction), not by the verb. Rewrite the trap as: 'indica ко всему, что знак сообщает; preannuncia подчёркивает, что событие ВПЕРЕДИ. Оба глагола встречаются с истинным ответом на знаках опасности — проверяйте содержание, а не глагол.' and drop the fabricated indica/preannuncia TRUE/FALSE pairs.

problems.problem: The Italian definition restricts preannuncia to danger signs — "è l'azione propria dei segnali di pericolo, collocati di norma 150 m prima del punto pericoloso". The bank uses preannuncia with TRUE answers on prescription/obbligo signs: on image 79fb6bac47fe4142.jpeg (topic 'Segnali di obbligo') q20121 'Il segnale raffigurato preannuncia l'unica direzione consentita' [TRUE], q20135 'preannuncia che non è consentito proseguire diritto' [TRUE], q20116 'preannuncia che non è consentito proseguire diritto o svoltare a sinistra' [TRUE]; and q20146 'preannuncia l'obbligo di svoltare a sinistra al prossimo incrocio' [TRUE]. It is also used on precedenza signs (q19469, q20604 'preannuncia l'incrocio con una strada senza diritto di precedenza' [TRUE]).
problems.correction: Broaden the definition: "Annuncia in anticipo ciò che si incontrerà più avanti; è tipico dei segnali di pericolo (posti di norma 150 m prima del punto pericoloso fuori dei centri abitati) ma vale anche per i segnali di preavviso di prescrizione o di direzione." Adjust ru/en/uz in step; the 150 m fact (confirmed by q18925) should be kept as an example, not as the defining property.

problems.problem: The trap asserts "For the danger sign: 'Il segnale raffigurato preannuncia una curva pericolosa a destra' is TRUE, while 'Il segnale raffigurato indica una curva pericolosa a destra' is FALSE" — implying the same sign with two verbs. In the database these are two different signs: q18924 (preannuncia, TRUE) is image bc12b1040dbee4ec.jpeg in topic 'Segnali di pericolo'; q20127 (indica, FALSE) is image 79fb6bac47fe4142.jpeg in topic 'Segnali di obbligo' — a mandatory-direction preavviso sign that has nothing to do with a curve. The statement is FALSE because the sign is not a curve sign at all. The 'pair' does not exist and the rule derived from it is false.
problems.correction: Remove the invented pair. If a contrast is wanted, use a real one from the same image: on bc12b1040dbee4ec.jpeg, q18924 'preannuncia una curva pericolosa a destra' [TRUE] vs q18935 'preannuncia una curva a sinistra' [FALSE] and q18932 'è un segnale di prescrizione' [FALSE] — i.e. the content, not the verb, is what is tested.

problems.problem: The trap states "'Il segnale raffigurato' opens 2729 of 7106 questions". No count in the database yields 2729: statements beginning with 'Il segnale raffigurato' = 2195; statements containing 'segnale raffigurato' = 2501; statements containing 'il segnale' anywhere = 2319; containing 'segnale' anywhere = 2782. (By contrast the 'raffigurato' entry's figure of 2833 is exactly right — that is the count for any form of 'raffigurat*' across stem_it/statement_it.) A wrong hard number in a trap that is otherwise correct undermines the entry's authority.
problems.correction: Replace with a verified figure: "«Il segnale raffigurato» apre 2195 delle 7106 domande (31%), e 'segnale raffigurato' compare in 2501." Keep the substantive point (segnale = знак / sign / yo'l belgisi, never сигнал / signal) unchanged.

problems.problem: The Russian gloss renders the class name 'segnale complementare' as "ДОПОЛНИТЕЛЬНОЕ средство сигнализации (segnale complementare)" — i.e. segnale becomes сигнализация. This is the exact collapse the project forbids, and it is load-bearing: the bank tests membership of the class directly — q21922 and q21932 'I delineatori raffigurati sono dei segnali complementari' [TRUE], q21941, q21943, q21951, q21982 [all TRUE]. A learner who has been told a delineatore is a 'средство сигнализации' rather than a дополнительный ЗНАК cannot recognise these as true. It also clashes with this very glossary's segnalazione entry, which defines сигнализация as the ACT of signalling (horn, hazard flashers, officer's gestures).
problems.correction: "делинеатор, сигнальный столбик — ДОПОЛНИТЕЛЬНЫЙ ДОРОЖНЫЙ ЗНАК (segnale complementare), устанавливаемый по краям проезжей части или в туннелях…" — keep знак, never сигнализация, for anything called segnale.

problems.problem: The Uzbek gloss renders 'segnale complementare' as "QO'SHIMCHA signal vositasi (segnale complementare)" — segnale rendered as 'signal', the forbidden mapping, and in the one place where class membership is what the bank actually tests (q21922/q21932/q21941/q21943/q21951/q21982 'sono dei segnali complementari' [TRUE]). It is also internally inconsistent with the same glossary's segnale entry, which correctly fixes segnale = yo'l belgisi.
problems.correction: "delineator, yo'l chekkasi ustunchasi — yo'lning yo'nalishini ko'rsatuvchi QO'SHIMCHA YO'L BELGISI (segnale complementare); yo'l chetiga yoki tunnellarga o'rnatiladi, ayniqsa ko'rinuvchanlik yomon bo'lganda foydali." Reserve 'signal' for segnalazione only.

problems.problem: The Russian gloss ends "…световая и дополнительная сигнализация", using сигнализация for segnaletica luminosa / complementare. The entry's own confusable_with list names segnalazione as the item to keep apart, and the segnalazione entry defines сигнализация as "подача сигнала (ДЕЙСТВИЕ)". So within one glossary сигнализация means both the collective body of road signs and the driver's act of signalling — precisely the merge the feature exists to prevent, and it drags segnale into сигнал by the back door.
problems.correction: "…: вертикальная (знаки и таблички), горизонтальная (линии и надписи на покрытии), световая (светофоры и светящиеся знаки) и дополнительные средства (делинеаторы, барьеры, конусы)." Use средства/знаки, and reserve сигнализация exclusively for segnalazione.

problems.problem: The Russian gloss opens "предписание, обязанность" and calls the signs "предписывающие знаки (segnali di obbligo)", while the segnale entry uses the same Russian word for the wider class: "делится на знаки опасности, предписывающие и информационные" = pericolo / PRESCRIZIONE / indicazione. So предписывающий denotes prescrizione in one entry and obbligo in another. The distinction is tested: on the DIVIETO DI SOSTA sign (image 765ea6a9fdb40802.jpeg) 'Il segnale raffigurato è un segnale di prescrizione' is [TRUE] although it is a divieto, not an obbligo; likewise q20120 [TRUE] / q20130 [FALSE] on image 79fb6bac47fe4142.jpeg separate 'prescrizione' from 'divieto'. A learner working from Russian cannot tell which class is being asked about.
problems.correction: Fix the Russian taxonomy consistently: prescrizione = "знаки предписания (общая группа: приоритет, запрет, обязанность)"; obbligo = "обязывающий (предписывающий) знак — круглый с синим фоном"; divieto = "запрещающий знак". Then change the segnale entry to "делится на знаки опасности, знаки ПРЕДПИСАНИЯ и информационные" so предписывающий is not reused for two different levels.

problems.problem: The definition says the divieto signs are "circolari a fondo bianco con bordo rosso". Two of the most heavily tested prohibition signs are not: DIVIETO DI SOSTA (fig. II 74) and DIVIETO DI FERMATA (fig. II 75) are round with a BLUE ground and a red border. The DIVIETO DI SOSTA sign carries a very large item family in the bank (image 765ea6a9fdb40802.jpeg has 35 statements, including 'Il segnale raffigurato è un segnale di prescrizione' [TRUE], 'vieta la sosta, ma non la fermata' [TRUE], 'consente la fermata' [TRUE]). A learner using colour as the recognition rule will fail to classify the blue prohibition signs as divieti. The error is carried identically into ru/en/uz.
problems.correction: "…i relativi segnali di divieto sono circolari, di norma a fondo bianco con bordo rosso; fanno eccezione DIVIETO DI SOSTA e DIVIETO DI FERMATA, a fondo azzurro con bordo rosso." Mirror in ru ("как правило, круглые с белым фоном и красной каймой; исключение — DIVIETO DI SOSTA и DIVIETO DI FERMATA: синий фон с красной каймой"), en and uz ("odatda oq fonli, qizil hoshiyali doira; DIVIETO DI SOSTA va DIVIETO DI FERMATA esa ko'k fonli, qizil hoshiyali").

problems.problem: sosta is rendered as bare "qo'yish": "to'xtash (fermata) ham, qo'yish (sosta) ham taqiqlanadi". 'qo'yish' on its own means 'putting/placing', not parking, and it is not the term used in the Uzbek Yo'l harakati qoidalari, which distinguishes to'xtash (= fermata/остановка) from to'xtab turish (= sosta/стоянка). This is exactly the arresto/fermata/sosta collapse the feature exists to stop, and the bank tests it head-on: q18350 'L'attraversamento pedonale è una parte della carreggiata in cui è consentita la fermata ma non la sosta' [FALSE], against q18342 (fermata vietata) [TRUE] and q18345 (sosta vietata) [TRUE]. An Uzbek learner reading 'qo'yish' has no stable term to attach the second rule to.
problems.correction: "…bu yerda to'xtash (fermata) ham, to'xtab turish (sosta) ham taqiqlanadi." Use to'xtash / to'xtab turish consistently for fermata / sosta throughout the glossary (the luce gialla and salvagente entries should be aligned to the same pair).

problems.problem: Trap point (3) says precedence is owed to "a blind pedestrian with a white or white-and-red stick". In Italian law the white-and-red stick identifies a DEAFBLIND pedestrian (sordocieco), not a blind one, and the bank tests that split explicitly: q18778 'il pedone sordocieco che, con il bastone bianco-rosso, attraversa la strada fuori dalle strisce pedonali' [TRUE], q18762 'Bisogna usare maggiore prudenza nei confronti dei pedoni muniti di bastone bianco, ma non di quelli con bastone bianco-rosso' [FALSE], q18797 'deve arrestarsi se il pedone è munito di bastone bianco-rosso; deve solo rallentare se, invece, è munito di bastone bianco' [FALSE], q18784 '…solo se munito di bastone bianco-rosso' [FALSE].
problems.correction: "(3) Precedenza is owed even OUTSIDE the stripes to a blind pedestrian with a white stick (bastone bianco) and to a deafblind pedestrian with a white-and-red stick (bastone bianco-rosso) — the duty is identical for both, which is what the bank tests."

problems.problem: The trap closes with "overtaking near or at an intersection is ALLOWED when the intersection is regolata da semafori …, a rule that has no counterpart for signs." The final clause is false in law and in the bank. Art. 148 C.d.S. lifts the same ban when the driver is on a road with right of way — a status conferred by a SIGN — and the bank tests it: q23506 'E' consentito il sorpasso nelle intersezioni se la strada è a precedenza purché a due carreggiate separate e le corsie siano delimitate dall'apposita segnaletica orizzontale' [TRUE]. It also lifts it for an officer directing traffic (q23509 shows the same logic at level crossings).
problems.correction: Drop the last clause: "…È consentito il sorpasso in prossimità o in corrispondenza delle intersezioni se regolate dai semafori (q23504, TRUE) — la stessa deroga vale se la circolazione è diretta da un agente o se si percorre una strada con diritto di precedenza (q23506, TRUE)." The teaching point about semaforo ≠ segnale ≠ segnalazione stands on its own.

problems.problem: The Russian gloss makes the right an exclusively road-level, permanent property: "постоянное свойство дороги (или направления движения)", matching the trap's "It is a permanent attribute of the road … not the momentary act". The bank also uses diritto di precedenza as a vehicle-to-vehicle relation at a specific junction: q23086 'Nell'incrocio rappresentato in figura il veicolo E ha diritto di precedenza sul veicolo B' [TRUE]; q23154 'il veicolo B, dato che svolta a sinistra, non ha diritto di precedenza su alcun veicolo' [FALSE]. A learner told the term can only describe a road will misread those items.
problems.correction: "право преимущественного проезда — право проехать первым: свойство дороги (или направления движения), обозначаемое знаками DIRITTO DI PRECEDENZA / FINE DEL DIRITTO DI PRECEDENZA, а также право конкретного водителя проехать перед другим на данном перекрёстке. Не путать с dare la precedenza — самим действием «уступить дорогу». Наличие права не освобождает от обязанности соблюдать осторожность." Amend the English trap's clause (1) the same way.

problems.problem: The Uzbek renders the obligation on a driver already inside the junction with 'lozim' ("chorrahaga allaqachon kirgan haydovchi esa uni tezroq bo'shatishi lozim"), which reads as advisable/ought, while the Italian is 'obbliga' — q21000 'La luce gialla fissa obbliga chi ha già impegnato l'incrocio a liberarlo al più presto' [TRUE]. This is the exact softening the glossary's own obbligo trap warns against ("an Uzbek or Russian rendering that softens obbligatorio into … kerak … flips the answer"), so the entry contradicts itself. Separately, the Russian for flashing amber ("разрешает проезд с повышенной осторожностью") drops the duty to slow down that the en/uz versions keep, and that is tested — q22909 'In vicinanza o in corrispondenza degli incroci non si deve rallentare se il semaforo è a luce gialla lampeggiante' [FALSE].
problems.correction: uz: "…chorrahaga allaqachon kirgan haydovchi esa uni imkon qadar tezroq bo'shatishi SHART." ru: "…МИГАЮЩИЙ (lampeggiante) разрешает проезд, но обязывает снизить скорость и проявлять максимальную осторожность."

problems.problem: The headword offers «полоса» as a synonym for striscia — but «полоса» is exactly the shipped Russian gloss for corsia (translations.py line 84: corsia RU: полоса). The entry therefore hands the learner the very swap its own trap forbids: «striscia continua» becomes "непрерывная полоса", which a Russian reads as a lane, not a painted line.
problems.correction: «линия разметки — линия горизонтальной разметки, нанесённая на покрытие; её цвет (белая, жёлтая) и тип (сплошная или прерывистая) определяют, что именно она предписывает. Не путать с corsia — полоса движения: striscia это линия, corsia это полоса между линиями.» Delete the bare «(полоса)» from the headword.

problems.problem: The Uzbek turns fixed amber into an unconditional duty: «DOIMIY (fissa) yonganda to'xtash chizig'idan oldin xavfsiz to'xtash shart» reads "you must stop safely before the stop line", where xavfsiz modifies the manner of stopping, not the condition for it. The Russian gets this right («если это можно сделать безопасно»); the Uzbek loses the conditional and so asserts precisely what the trap says is FALSE — «La luce gialla fissa ci obbliga ad arrestarci in ogni caso».
problems.correction: «DOIMIY (fissa) — agar xavfsiz to'xtash imkoni bo'lsa, to'xtash chizig'i oldida to'xtash shart; chorrahaga allaqachon kirgan haydovchi esa uni imkon qadar tezroq bo'shatishi lozim; MILTILLOVCHI (lampeggiante) — katta ehtiyotkorlik bilan, tezlikni pasaytirgan holda o'tishga ruxsat beradi.» (Also fixes the broken coordination «katta ehtiyotkorlik va tezlikni pasaytirgan holda», which needs «ehtiyotkorlik bilan».)

problems.problem: «qo'yish (sosta)» is not a term — bare qo'yish means "to put/place" and matches nothing in the shipped glossary, which has sosta = turish (parking) (translations.py line 91). And «to'xtash (fermata)» hands fermata the word the same glossary reserves for arresto (line 89: arresto = to'xtash, fermata = qisqa to'xtash). One entry breaks the arresto/fermata/sosta triple in both directions.
problems.correction: «…haydovchilar piyodalarga yo'l berishi shart; bu yerda qisqa to'xtash (fermata) ham, turib qolish/parking (sosta) ham taqiqlanadi.» Keep the shipped triple everywhere: arresto = to'xtash, fermata = qisqa to'xtash, sosta = turish.

problems.problem: «nazoratchining ishoralari» is the wrong official term. Nazoratchi means an inspector/supervisor (a person who checks things), not a traffic officer directing traffic. Uzbek YHQ has a defined term for this exact role — tartibga soluvchi (регулировщик) — and that is the word an Uzbek learner has already met in their home driving theory.
problems.correction: «segnalazione degli agenti — tartibga soluvchi (yo'l harakatini boshqaruvchi xodim) ishoralari». Also replace the calque «signal berish akti» — akt in Uzbek is a legal deed; use «signal berish harakati yoki vositasi».

problems.problem: The three verbs collapse in Uzbek, which is the one thing this entry family exists to prevent. preannuncia = «oldindan ogohlantiradi» but its own body then says «xabar beradi»; preavvisa = «oldindan xabar beradi» with the body «ma'lum qiladi». So xabar beradi is the head verb of one entry and the body verb of the other, and both open with oldindan. A learner cannot build two distinct question families out of that.
problems.correction: Assign one root per verb and never reuse it in another entry's body: indica = ko'rsatadi; preannuncia = ogohlantiradi (oldindan); preavvisa = ma'lum qiladi. For this entry: «oldindan ma'lum qiladi — oldinda uchraydigan BUYRUQ yoki yo'nalishni maxsus preavviso belgisi orqali, ko'pincha masofa ko'rsatilgan holda, oldindan ma'lum qiladi.» Also fix «kutilayotgan buyruq» ("an expected order" reads odd) → «oldinda uchraydigan buyruq».

problems.problem: Same collapse from the other side: the definition body «OLDINDA uchraydigan narsa haqida xabar beradi» uses preavvisa's head verb, so the two entries explain each other with each other's words. «narsa haqida» ("about a thing") is also vague where the Italian is specific — danger signs preannounce a hazard, not a "thing".
problems.correction: «oldindan ogohlantiradi — yo'lda OLDINDA uchraydigan xavf haqida ogohlantiradi; bu ogohlantiruvchi (xavf) belgilarining vazifasi, ular aholi punktlaridan tashqarida odatda xavfli joydan 150 m oldin o'rnatiladi.» Keep ogohlantir- exclusive to preannuncia.

problems.problem: «предварительно извещает» and preannuncia's «предупреждает заранее» are near-synonyms to a Russian ear — both mean "tells you in advance" — so the pair the bank deliberately contrasts stays textually indistinguishable. The entry is also internally inconsistent: the headword says «предварительный знак», the body says «знак предварительного указания».
problems.correction: Use three visibly different Russian verbs: indica = указывает, preannuncia = предупреждает (заранее), preavvisa = предварительно оповещает. And pick one sign name — Russian road terminology already has «предварительный указатель»: «предварительно оповещает — заранее сообщает о ПРЕДПИСАНИИ или направлении, которые появятся дальше, с помощью особого предварительного указателя (segnale di preavviso), часто с указанием расстояния.»

problems.problem: fermata is glossed as bare «остановка», which is the shipped gloss for arresto (translations.py line 89: arresto RU: остановка (полная); line 90: fermata RU: кратковременная остановка). On the one item where the trap says the arresto/fermata/sosta distinction bites hardest, the entry uses the wrong member of the triple.
problems.correction: «…на нём запрещены и кратковременная остановка (fermata), и стоянка (sosta).» Keep «остановка» reserved for arresto across all entries.

problems.problem: «предписание» is given as the first gloss of obbligo, but предписание is the natural Russian for prescrizione — the wider class that contains obbligo, divieto and precedenza. The entry then says obbligo signs «входят в группу знаков предписания», so the same Russian word names both the member and the class. A learner who reads «предписание» in a question cannot tell whether a blue round sign or the whole red/blue family is meant.
problems.correction: «обязанность, обязательное предписание — требование, ОБЯЗЫВАЮЩЕЕ вести себя определённым образом; предписывающие знаки (segnali di obbligo) — круглые с синим фоном — входят в группу знаков предписания (segnali di prescrizione).» Reserve the bare noun «предписание» for prescrizione alone. Note that «предписывающие знаки» is already the exact ПДД РФ name for blue round signs, so that part is well chosen — it is only the headword that needs changing.

problems.problem: «белой «зеброй»» is wrong and actively harmful: in Russian «зебра» means a pedestrian crossing and nothing else. The Italian marking here is the diagonal hatching (zebratura/campitura). As written, the entry tells the learner that a traffic island is bounded by a pedestrian crossing — and it does so in the one entry whose trap is "this is not the salvagente".
problems.correction: «…обозначенная сплошными белыми линиями и белой диагональной штриховкой («ёлочка»), в одном уровне с проезжей частью или приподнятая, въезд на которую запрещён; служит для распределения транспортных потоков по разным направлениям.» This also removes the tautology «для направления потоков … по разным направлениям» and the ungrammatical «часть дороги, ЗАПРЕЩЁННАЯ для проезда».

problems.problem: «oq zebra» carries the same false cue as the Russian — in Uzbek zebra is unambiguously the pedestrian crossing (entry 17 is literally piyodalar o'tish joyi, the zebra). The marking meant is diagonal hatching.
problems.correction: «…uzluksiz oq chiziqlar va qiya shtrixlangan (yo'l-yo'l) belgilash bilan chegaralangan, yo'l sathida yoki ko'tarilgan, ustidan yurish TAQIQLANGAN yo'l qismi; transport oqimlarini turli yo'nalishlarga taqsimlash uchun xizmat qiladi.»

problems.problem: Two problems in one sentence. (1) «вертикальная (знаки и таблички), горизонтальная (линии …), световая и дополнительная сигнализация» is a word-for-word calque of segnaletica verticale/orizzontale — Russian has no «вертикальная сигнализация»; the established renderings are simply дорожные знаки and дорожная разметка. (2) It settles on «сигнализация» as the Russian for segnaletica, while entry 18 uses «сигнализация» for segnalazione. The two Italian words the whole feature separates end up sharing one Russian noun.
problems.correction: «дорожные знаки и разметка (технические средства организации движения) — собирательное понятие, охватывающее: segnaletica verticale — дорожные знаки и таблички; segnaletica orizzontale — разметку (линии и надписи на покрытии); световые средства (светофоры) и дополнительные средства (столбики, конусы, ограждения).» Drop «сигнализация» from this entry entirely and leave it to segnalazione.

problems.problem: The definition of знак is built on «средство вертикальной сигнализации» — so the very entry whose trap is "segnale is NEVER сигнал" defines it with the root сигнал. It is also opaque: a Russian learner has no concept «вертикальная сигнализация», and the phrase is a direct calque of segnaletica verticale.
problems.correction: «знак (дорожный знак) — устанавливаемое у дороги техническое средство организации движения (относится к вертикальным средствам — в отличие от горизонтальной разметки), которое предупреждает об опасности, предписывает поведение или сообщает информацию; делится на знаки опасности, знаки предписания и информационные знаки.» Also align the class name with the obbligo/divieto entries, which say «знаки предписания», not «предписывающие».

problems.problem: The three sign families are named with coinages that no Uzbek learner has seen: «xavf, buyruq-taqiq va axborot belgilari». Uzbek YHQ, which this audience studied at home, uses ogohlantiruvchi belgilar (danger), taqiqlovchi belgilar, buyuruvchi belgilar, and axborot-ko'rsatma belgilari. Worse, the invented class name buyruq-taqiq names the class by two of its members, so in entry 11 obbligo (buyruq) belongs to the buyruq-taqiq group — circular. «vertikal belgi» is the same calque as the Russian, and «qoidani buyuradi» is odd (it orders a rule).
problems.correction: «yo'l belgisi — yo'l chetiga o'rnatiladigan, harakatni tartibga soluvchi vosita (gorizontal chiziqlardan farqli o'laroq vertikal guruhga kiradi): xavfdan ogohlantiradi, muayyan xatti-harakatni buyuradi yoki ma'lumot beradi; ogohlantiruvchi, ko'rsatma (buyuruvchi va taqiqlovchi) hamda axborot belgilariga bo'linadi.» Use ko'rsatma belgilari for segnali di prescrizione and drop buyruq-taqiq from entries 1, 11, 12 and 19.

problems.problem: «сигнальный столбик» is only one member of the delineatore family, and the trap's own TRUE example — «Il delineatore raffigurato indica una curva pericolosa a destra» — is the chevron panel (delineatore modulare di curva), which is not a столбик at all. A learner primed to see a roadside post will answer FALSE on a chevron picture. Separately, «делинеатор» is not a Russian word learners know, and «средство сигнализации» reintroduces the сигнал root the segnale trap bans.
problems.correction: «направляющее устройство (сигнальный столбик, а также щиток с шевронами на повороте) — ДОПОЛНИТЕЛЬНЫЙ знак (segnale complementare), устанавливаемый по краям проезжей части или в туннелях, чтобы показать, куда идёт дорога; особенно полезен при плохой видимости.» Keep «делинеатор» only as a parenthetical transliteration, not as the headword.

problems.problem: «QO'SHIMCHA signal vositasi» uses signal — the exact word the segnale entry forbids — for an object that gives no signal at all, and pushes the learner toward svetofor/klakson. «delineator» is a bare transliteration that means nothing in Uzbek, and «ko'rinuvchanlik» is a Russian-engineering calque of видимость.
problems.correction: «signal ustunchasi (yo'l chekkasi ustunchasi) — yo'lning yo'nalishini ko'rsatish uchun yo'l chetiga yoki tunnellarga o'rnatiladigan QO'SHIMCHA belgilash vositasi (segnale complementare); ayniqsa ko'rish sharoiti yomon bo'lganda foydali.» Lead with the descriptive Uzbek, not the transliteration.

problems.problem: This contradicts the glossary that governs the actual question translations: /srv/patente/api/services/translations.py line 82 pins segnale luminoso RU: светофор. A learner will read «светофор» inside the translated question and «световой знак / светосигнальное устройство» in the glossary card and treat them as two different objects. «светосигнальное устройство» also carries the сигнал root into an entry about a segnale, and «ст. 41 ПДД Италии» mislabels the Codice della Strada.
problems.correction: «световой знак (в вопросах — почти всегда светофор) — знак, подаваемый светящимися устройствами (ст. 41 Дорожного кодекса Италии, Codice della Strada): светофорные секции для транспорта, пешеходов, велосипедистов и отдельных полос, а также светящиеся знаки опасности и информации.» Either adopt this in both places or update the glossary line so the two agree.

problems.problem: «островок безопасности» is the right Russian term, but ПДД РФ defines островок безопасности as an element that also separates traffic streams and may be marked only by hatching 1.16.1–1.16.3 — i.e. it covers what Italian law calls isola di traffico. A Russian learner therefore arrives with the two Italian concepts already merged, and neither entry warns them. This is the merge the bank tests directly («Il salvagente serve a incanalare i veicoli» FALSE).
problems.correction: Add an explicit contrast to both entries: in salvagente — «…для посадки и высадки пассажиров. Не путать с isola di traffico (направляющий островок): salvagente служит ЛЮДЯМ, isola di traffico направляет ТРАНСПОРТ.»; and the mirror sentence in isola di traffico. Also replace «служащий убежищем» — «убежище» reads as a bomb shelter — with «служащий укрытием и местом ожидания».

problems.problem: «buyruq belgilari» is not the term Uzbek learners know — Uzbek YHQ says buyuruvchi belgilar (and taqiqlovchi belgilar, which entry 12 correctly uses). The two entries are inconsistent with each other, and the class label «buyruq-taqiq belgilari guruhi» contains the entry's own headword, so obbligo appears to be a member of a class named after itself.
problems.correction: «majburiyat, majburiy ko'rsatma — muayyan xatti-harakatni bajarishga majbur qiluvchi talab; buyuruvchi belgilar (segnali di obbligo) — ko'k fonli dumaloq belgilar — ko'rsatma belgilari (segnali di prescrizione) guruhiga kiradi.»

problems.problem: «полосный» is not a Russian word in this sense — no Russian driver says «полосный светофор». «установка светофорных секций» defines светофор through светофорных, and «регулирующая движение красным, жёлтым и зелёным огнём» puts three colours in one singular «огнём».
problems.correction: «светофор — устройство, регулирующее движение сигналами красного, жёлтого и зелёного цвета; бывает транспортный, пешеходный, велосипедный, для отдельной полосы движения и реверсивный.»

problems.problem: «svetofor — … svetofor qurilmasi» defines the word with itself. «qatorlar uchun» uses qator for lane, while the shipped glossary sets corsia = yo'lak (translations.py line 84); the app will show a learner two different Uzbek words for the same Italian noun. «piyoda, velosiped» as bare modifiers of turlari is clipped.
problems.correction: «svetofor — harakatni qizil, sariq va yashil chiroqlar bilan tartibga soluvchi qurilma; transport uchun, piyodalar uchun, velosipedchilar uchun, alohida yo'lak uchun va yo'nalishi o'zgaruvchan (reversiv) yo'laklar uchun turlari bor.» Pick yo'lak or qator for corsia and use it in every entry.

problems.problem: «щиток» is the wrong genus word — in Russian щиток is a dashboard or an electrical panel, not a sign plate. The correct and already-familiar ПДД РФ term is табличка (знаки дополнительной информации), which the headword thankfully uses; the body then contradicts it.
problems.correction: «дополнительная табличка — прямоугольная табличка, установленная ПОД знаком и уточняющая его: расстояние до начала действия, протяжённость участка, время действия, категории транспортных средств или исключения.»

problems.problem: «lavha» is the correct Uzbek YHQ term and is already in the headword, but the body then re-labels it «taxtacha» (a little plank) — colloquial and inconsistent. «amal boshlanadigan masofa» is ungrammatical (amal needs qilish), and «transport toifalari» is clipped for transport vositalari toifalari.
problems.correction: «qo'shimcha lavha — belgi OSTIGA o'rnatiladigan va uning ma'nosini aniqlashtiruvchi lavha: amal qilish boshlanadigan masofa, uchastka uzunligi, amal qilish vaqti, transport vositalari toifalari yoki istisnolar.»

problems.problem: «ehtiyotkorlik majburiyatidan ozod qilmaydi» is a word-for-word calque of «не освобождает от обязанности» — ozod qilmoq in Uzbek means to liberate (a person, a country) and reads oddly about a duty. The sentence is also the legally load-bearing half of the entry, so it should be the clearest one.
problems.correction: «…ustunlik huquqi bo'lsa ham, haydovchi ehtiyotkorlikni saqlashi shart — bu huquq uni ehtiyot bo'lish majburiyatidan xalos etmaydi.»

problems.problem: «постоянное свойство дороги» is a calque of attributo della strada and sounds abstract. Russian learners already have the exact mental model under a different name — главная дорога — and the entry never connects the two, which is the fastest way to make «strada che gode del diritto di precedenza» click.
problems.correction: «право преимущественного проезда — постоянное право, закреплённое за дорогой или направлением движения (итальянский аналог «главной дороги»), обозначаемое знаками DIRITTO DI PRECEDENZA и FINE DEL DIRITTO DI PRECEDENZA; оно не освобождает водителя от обязанности соблюдать осторожность. Не путать с dare la precedenza — уступить дорогу (разовое действие).»

problems.problem: «razmetka» is an untranslated Russian loan used twice, in an entry that already has the correct Uzbek («yo'l chizig'i»). Uzbek-dominant learners who do not read Russian get nothing from it. The entry also omits the corsia contrast that its own trap calls the main risk, and «qanday talab qo'yishini belgilaydi» is clumsy.
problems.correction: «yo'l chizig'i — yo'l qoplamasiga chizilgan gorizontal belgilash chizig'i; rangi (oq, sariq) va turi (uzluksiz yoki uzuq-uzuq) qanday qoida o'rnatishini bildiradi. Chiziq (striscia) bilan yo'lak (corsia) ni aralashtirmang: chiziq — chizilgan chiziq, yo'lak — chiziqlar orasidagi harakat qismi.»

problems.problem: «savol ilova qilingan rasmga havola qiladigan sifatdosh» parses badly — the reader first sees «savol ilova qilingan» ("the question that was attached") before recovering the intended structure, and havola qilmoq is for linking documents rather than pointing at a picture. The Russian version of the same entry is clear; the Uzbek is not.
problems.correction: «tasvirlangan (rasmdagi) — savoldagi rasmga ishora qiluvchi sifatdosh: «il segnale raffigurato» — rasmda ko'rsatilgan aynan shu belgi, umuman har qanday belgi emas.»

problems.problem: «amalga oshirilgan» is a Russian calque (выполненный/реализованный) and reads bureaucratically about a lamp. «yorituvchi xavf va axborot belgilari» has the wrong participle voice — yorituvchi means "that illuminates (something else)", where the sense is "illuminated". «chiroqli signal qurilmasi» again puts signal into a segnale entry, and «svetofor sektsiyalari» is engineering Russian.
problems.correction: «yorug'likli belgi (chiroqli belgi qurilmasi) — chiroqlar yordamida beriladigan yo'l belgisi (Italiya Yo'l kodeksi, 41-modda): transport, piyodalar, velosipedchilar va alohida yo'laklar uchun svetofor chiroqlarini hamda yoritiladigan xavf va axborot belgilarini o'z ichiga oladi.»

problems.problem: «oldinroqda emas» means "not somewhat further ahead" — the -roq softens exactly the contrast with preannuncia that the entry is built on. The sentence also repeats bildiradi / bildirishini / ifodalaydi in one line, and it closes with the non-standard class names («buyruq, taqiq va axborot belgilari»).
problems.correction: «ko'rsatadi (SHU YERDA amal qiladigan narsani bildiradi) — belgi o'rnatilgan JOYDA nimani buyurishi yoki qanday ma'lumot berishini anglatadi, yo'lning oldindagi qismida emas; bu buyuruvchi, taqiqlovchi va axborot belgilarining fe'li.»

problems.problem: Both the Italian definition ("Parte della carreggiata…") and the trap ("A corsia is part OF a carreggiata, never the reverse") state as absolute something the bank explicitly falsifies. Q18475 'Fanno parte della carreggiata le corsie di emergenza delle autostrade' = FALSO, while Q18487 'La corsia può essere destinata alle soste di emergenza, in caso di guasto o malessere' = VERO. So a corsia di emergenza IS a corsia and is NOT part of the carreggiata. CdS art.3 n.19 likewise defines corsia as 'parte longitudinale della strada', not della carreggiata. A learner who internalises the trap answers 18475 wrong. (The trap's other two claims, 18494 and 18491, are correct.)
problems.correction: IT: 'Parte longitudinale della strada, di larghezza sufficiente al transito di una sola fila di veicoli; le corsie di marcia fanno parte della carreggiata, la corsia di emergenza no.' Trap: replace 'never the reverse' with 'the corsie di marcia, di sorpasso, di accelerazione e di decelerazione fanno parte della carreggiata; la corsia di emergenza è una corsia ma NON fa parte della carreggiata (18475 FALSO). La corsia non è mai formata da carreggiate (18494) e non può essere a doppio senso (18491).'

problems.problem: The trap states the curve/dosso exception too narrowly and the prohibition too absolutely. It says sorpasso is 'CONSENTITO in curve and on dossi where the road has separate carriageways with at least two lanes per direction'. The bank grants the exception on much weaker conditions: 23556 'Il sorpasso in prossimità di un dosso è consentito sulle strade a senso unico' = VERO, 23557 (carreggiate a senso unico) = VERO, 23558 'strade a due corsie per senso di marcia' = VERO, 23540 'Il sorpasso è vietato sulle curve e sui dossi delle strade a senso unico' = FALSO, 23527 'vietato in curva anche se la strada è ad almeno due corsie per senso' = FALSO, 20855/20858 (senso unico, figure). A learner applying the stated condition marks 23556/23557/23540/23527 wrong. Worse, 23519 'E' consentito il sorpasso sul tratto discendente di un dosso in una strada a due corsie a doppio senso di marcia' = VERO, so even the ban half is not absolute.
problems.correction: Trap: 'Vietato in prossimità/corrispondenza di curve e dossi solo su carreggiata a due corsie e doppio senso (23494, 23495) — e nemmeno lì in assoluto: sul tratto DISCENDENTE di un dosso è consentito (23519). È consentito ogni volta che manca il conflitto con il senso opposto: strade o carreggiate a senso unico (23556, 23557), strade con almeno due corsie per senso (23558, 23527 FALSO), carreggiate separate (23497, 23526 FALSO).'

problems.problem: The trap's second sentence — 'On a two-lane two-way road the phrase alone already forbids sorpasso in curve and on dossi' — is contradicted by 23519 'E' consentito il sorpasso sul tratto discendente di un dosso in una strada a due corsie a doppio senso di marcia' = VERO. The phrase alone does not settle the item; the position on the dosso (ascending vs descending) does. Same over-absolute framing as the sorpasso entry.
problems.correction: 'Su carreggiata a due corsie e doppio senso il sorpasso è vietato in curva e in prossimità/corrispondenza dei dossi (23494, 23495) — ma sul tratto discendente di un dosso è consentito (23519). Il primo periodo del trap resta valido: la carreggiata può essere a doppio senso, la corsia no (18461 VERO / 18491 FALSO).'

problems.problem: The trap's final sentence 'A passaggio a livello is not an incrocio' is false in law and contradicts this glossary's own passaggio a livello entry, whose Italian definition reads 'Intersezione a raso fra una strada e una linea ferroviaria…' — which is CdS art.3 n.32 verbatim. Since the same trap insists incrocio and intersezione name the SAME object, the two entries assert both that a passaggio a livello is an intersezione a raso and that it is not an incrocio. The bank item that seems to support the claim, 18401 'L'intersezione (incrocio) a raso è un passaggio a livello dotato di barriere o semibarriere' = FALSO, is false only because the converse does not hold (not every intersezione a raso is a passaggio a livello), not because a passaggio a livello fails to be one.
problems.correction: Replace with: 'Il discriminante è sempre a raso vs a livelli sfalsati, mai il sostantivo (18392 FALSO). Attenzione al verso: il passaggio a livello È un'intersezione a raso fra strada e ferrovia, ma un'intersezione a raso NON è un passaggio a livello né un passo carrabile né un incrocio con i binari del tram (18399, 18400, 18401 tutti FALSI).'

problems.problem: The English gloss 'verge / hard shoulder' merges banchina with corsia di emergenza — the very item listed in its own confusable_with — and the two carry opposite rules. Banchina: 23761 'La sosta è vietata sulle banchine, salvo diversa segnalazione' = VERO, 23714 'il conducente deve collocare il veicolo in sosta fuori della carreggiata, ma non sulle banchine' = VERO, 18511 'non consente, di norma, il transito ai veicoli' = VERO. Corsia di emergenza: 20955 'si può utilizzare in caso di guasto del veicolo, per un massimo di tre ore' = VERO, 23899 'è consentito fermarsi sulla corsia per la sosta di emergenza' = VERO. An English-side learner reading 'hard shoulder' gets the breakdown-stop rule exactly backwards.
problems.correction: EN: 'verge / soft shoulder — the part of the road outside the carriageway, beyond the continuous white edge line; as a rule open neither to traffic nor to parking. NOT the motorway hard shoulder, which is the corsia di emergenza and is the one place a breakdown stop is allowed.' Add the same warning to the trap field.

problems.problem: Two defects. (1) The body of the Uzbek gloss reads '…yuzaga keladigan to'xtash' — it defines arresto using to'xtash, which this glossary itself reserves for fermata (see the sosta trap: 'Glossing it with … UZ to'xtash merges it with fermata'). The entry commits the exact merge it warns against, and it is the merge that decides 23642 vs 23647. (2) 'nazoratchi' is not the Uzbek road-code term for agente del traffico / regolatore; nazoratchi means an overseer or inspector. The O'zbekiston YHQ term is tartibga soluvchi.
problems.correction: UZ: 'harakat talabiga ko'ra majburan to'xtatilish — qizil chiroq, STOP belgisi yoki tartibga soluvchi talabi bilan yuzaga keladigan harakatning uzilishi; haydovchining xohishi bilan emas.' Avoid the bare noun to'xtash anywhere in the arresto and sosta entries.

problems.problem: 'piazzole di sosta' is rendered 'to'xtash maydonchalari'. to'xtash is the word this glossary assigns to fermata (sosta = to'xtab turish). Using it for sosta inside the carreggiata definition undermines the sosta/fermata separation the whole category is built on, and this is the exact wording pattern behind 18470 'La carreggiata comprende le piazzole di sosta' = FALSO vs 23691 'La fermata è consentita allo sbocco dei passi carrabili' = VERO.
problems.correction: UZ: '…velosiped yo'lagi va to'xtab turish maydonchalarini o'z ichiga olmaydi.'

problems.problem: Two narrowings. (1) 'to'xtash joyidan' renders 'dalla sosta' with to'xtash — again fermata's word used for sosta. (2) 'hovlidan' ('from the courtyard') is much narrower than 'da un'area privata'; the Russian gloss correctly has 'прилегающей территории'. The bank tests immissione from passi carrabili, aree private and parking generally (22970–22975, 24227, 22662–22671), not just house yards.
problems.correction: UZ: 'harakat oqimiga qo'shilish — yon yo'ldan, yondosh hududdan (hovli, avtoturargoh) yoki to'xtab turish joyidan harakat oqimiga chiqish manevri; harakatdagi transportga yo'l berish shart.'

problems.problem: The Russian gloss ends '…делится на полосы', asserting as a fact what Italian law and the bank state only as a possibility. IT says 'Può essere suddivisa in corsie' and EN correctly says 'may be divided into lanes'; only RU drops the modality. Bank 18462 is 'La carreggiata PUÒ essere suddivisa in corsie' = VERO, and the category's whole può/sempre trap family (18460, 18461 VERO; 18470, 18475, 18476, 18477 FALSO) turns on that modal. A carriageway with a single lane per direction is not divided at all.
problems.correction: RU: '…не включает тротуары, обочины, велодорожки и карманы для стоянки; МОЖЕТ делиться на полосы движения.'

problems.problem: 'водитель обязан оставаться за рулём' is stricter than the law it glosses. CdS art.157 and bank 23653 say 'il conducente deve essere sempre PRESENTE e pronto a riprendere la marcia' — present at the vehicle, not necessarily seated at the wheel. The rule the bank actually tests is the allontanamento ban (23656 'può allontanarsi per brevissimo tempo' = FALSO; 23658 = FALSO), and 23795/23798 explicitly contemplate opening doors and getting out. Rendering 'presente' as 'за рулём' invents a duty and blurs why the sosta/fermata line is about walking away.
problems.correction: RU: '…водитель обязан находиться при транспортном средстве и быть готовым немедленно продолжить движение (отлучаться нельзя даже ненадолго).'

problems.problem: Same over-restriction as the Russian: 'haydovchi rulda qolishi shart' ('must stay at the wheel') for 'deve restare presente e pronto a riprendere la marcia' (23653). Separately, 'odamlarni tushirish/o'tqazish' reverses the Italian order (salita o discesa = boarding then alighting) and o'tqazish means 'to seat someone', a calque of Russian посадка rather than the Uzbek boarding verb.
problems.correction: UZ: 'to'xtash — odamlarning chiqishi yoki tushishi, yoxud juda qisqa muddatli ehtiyoj uchun harakatning vaqtincha to'xtatilishi; haydovchi transport vositasi yonida bo'lishi va harakatni darhol davom ettirishga tayyor turishi shart (uzoqlashishi mumkin emas).'

problems.problem: '(pereyezd)' is a bare transliteration of the Russian переезд dropped into the Uzbek gloss — precisely the RU-transliteration failure this feature is meant to avoid. It is not an Uzbek word and carries no meaning for a Latin-script Uzbek reader who does not already know Russian. 'temiryo'l' is also written solid; standard Uzbek orthography is two words, 'temir yo'l'.
problems.correction: UZ: 'temir yo'l kesishmasi — yo'l va temir yo'lning (yoki alohida yo'ldagi tramvay yo'lining) bir sathda kesishishi; to'siqli, yarim to'siqli yoki to'siqsiz bo'lishi mumkin.' Drop '(pereyezd)'.

problems.problem: '(yelka)' glosses banchina with the anatomical word for a shoulder — a calque of English 'shoulder'. It is not an Uzbek road term and, since the English gloss of the same entry already wrongly says 'hard shoulder', it reinforces the banchina/corsia di emergenza merge rather than separating them.
problems.correction: UZ: 'yo'l cheti — yo'lning qatnov qismidan tashqarida, uzluksiz chekka chizig'i ortida joylashgan qismi; odatda unda harakatlanish ham, to'xtab turish ham mumkin emas (favqulodda to'xtash yo'lagi bilan adashtirmang).' Remove '(yelka)'.

problems.problem: 'yo'l (butun bo'yicha)' is not grammatical Uzbek — it is a word-for-word calque of the Russian parenthetical '(в целом)'. 'butun bo'yicha' reads as 'according to the whole' and does not convey 'taken as a whole', which is the distinction the entry exists to make against carreggiata and corsia (18436, 18437 VERO; 18441, 18444 FALSO).
problems.correction: UZ: 'yo'l (yaxlit holda) — piyodalar, transport vositalari va hayvonlar harakati uchun umumiy foydalanishdagi hudud…'

problems.problem: 'bir xil qatnov qismida' means 'on the same KIND of carriageway', not 'on the same one'. The Italian condition is 'sulla stessa carreggiata', and it is load-bearing: it is what separates sorpasso from merely passing a vehicle travelling on a physically separate carriageway. The sibling entry sorpassare drops the condition altogether.
problems.correction: UZ: 'quvib o'tish — o'sha bir qatnov qismida oldinda ketayotgan transport vositasini o'z qatoridan chiqib o'zib o'tish va keyin qatorga qaytish manevri; odatda chapdan.' Add 'o'sha bir qatnov qismida' to sorpassare too.

problems.problem: 'umumiy qoida (o'ngdagiga)' is an incomplete phrase — the noun is left dangling with no verb, so it reads as 'general rule (to the one on the right)' and does not state which way the duty runs. The RU ('помеха справа') and EN ('yield to the right') both state the direction. Given that the entry's own trap warns the two sides of precedenza get swapped between item versions, leaving the Uzbek directionless is exactly the wrong place to be terse.
problems.correction: UZ: '…umumiy qoida (o'ngdan kelayotganga yo'l berish), yo'l belgisi yoki svetofor bilan aniqlanadi.'

problems.problem: The RU gloss ('самостоятельное нарушение с собственной санкцией') and the parallel EN ('a named offence carrying its own sanction') assert a legal status the Codice does not give it. Intralcio is not a free-standing infraction: it is an element that qualifies other duties — art.141 on velocità ('la velocità … deve essere regolata in modo da non causare intralcio', bank 22384), art.157 on fermata (23650 'La fermata non deve arrecare intralcio alla circolazione'), art.148 on sorpasso (23458). The bank contains no item attaching a sanction or point loss to intralcio as such.
problems.correction: RU: 'создание помех движению — затруднение или замедление движения других участников; правовая категория, которой Кодекс обусловливает нормы о скорости, остановке и обгоне, а не бытовое неудобство.' Same edit to the EN gloss ('a legal category qualifying the speed, stopping and overtaking rules').

problems.problem: The definition ends "o'sha yo'ldan orqaga yurish". "Orqaga yurish" is the standard Uzbek phrase for reversing / задний ход — i.e. retromarcia. So the Uzbek entry for the U-turn literally defines it as backing up, which is the precise merge the trap forbids (inversione vs retromarcia vs svolta). A learner reading this will answer DIVIETO DI INVERSIONE items as if the sign banned reversing.
problems.correction: burilib qaytish — harakat yo'nalishini qarama-qarshi tomonga o'zgartirib, o'sha yo'lda teskari yo'nalishda harakatlanish manevri; bu orqaga yurish (retromarcia) ham, burilish (svolta) ham emas.

problems.problem: "nazoratchi talabi bilan" — nazoratchi means supervisor, inspector, watchman. It is not the road-traffic officer. The Uzbek YHQ term for регулировщик / agente del traffico is "harakatni tartibga soluvchi". As written, the learner does not connect this to the vigile directing traffic at all.
problems.correction: …qizil chiroq, STOP belgisi yoki harakatni tartibga soluvchi talabi bilan…

problems.problem: The headword is "to'xtatish" but the body then says "…yuzaga keladigan to'xtash" — to'xtash is the headword of the fermata entry. The arresto entry therefore defines itself with fermata's word, collapsing the two exactly where the bank tests them apart ('l'arresto è la temporanea sospensione della marcia per esigenze del conducente' FALSE).
problems.correction: …qizil chiroq, STOP belgisi yoki harakatni tartibga soluvchi talabi bilan yuzaga keladigan majburiy to'xtatilish; haydovchining xohishi bilan emas (bu fermata = to'xtash emas).

problems.problem: "to'xtash maydonchalari" is used for the piazzole di sosta. In this glossary's own scheme to'xtash = fermata and to'xtab turish = sosta (matching the Uzbek YHQ 5-minute split). Writing to'xtash here re-merges the pair inside the very entry that is supposed to keep the road units apart.
problems.correction: …velosiped yo'li va to'xtab turish maydonchalarini o'z ichiga olmaydi.

problems.problem: "to'xtash joyidan" for "со стоянки / dal parcheggio" uses to'xtash (fermata) where the place meant is a parking area = to'xtab turish. Same fermata/sosta collapse as in carreggiata.
problems.correction: …yon yo'ldan, yondosh hududdan yoki to'xtab turish joyidan…

problems.problem: "yo'l cheti (yelka)" — yelka is the human shoulder. It is a calque of the English 'shoulder' and reads as an anatomical term to an Uzbek speaker; it is not a road-vocabulary word. "yo'l cheti" alone is the correct and sufficient YHQ term.
problems.correction: Drop the parenthesis: "yo'l cheti — yo'lning qatnov qismidan tashqarida…"

problems.problem: The headword says "asosiy shaharlararo yo'l" (intercity road) but its own body says "shahardan tashqari yo'l" (outside the built-up area). Extraurbana is defined by the aholi punkti boundary, not by connecting two cities — a road can be extraurbana and go nowhere near a second city. Headword and body contradict each other.
problems.correction: shahardan tashqari asosiy yo'l (B toifa) — aholi punktidan tashqarida joylashgan, qatnov qismlari ajratilgan…

problems.problem: "красный сигнал" appears bare. In everyday Russian this is correct for a traffic light, but this glossary's single most-repeated rule is segnale = знак, NEVER сигнал.
